docs.text: AFM-4.5B is a 4.5 billion parameter instruction-tuned model from Arcee AI designed for enterprise deployment across cloud and edge environments. It is a decoder-only transformer trained on 8 trillion tokens with an emphasis on mathematical reasoning and code generation.

Runway's character performance model: you supply a driving performance video of someone acting out a scene plus a character image or video, and Act-Two transfers the movement, expressions, audio and gestures onto that character.

With adaptive translation you provide the text to translate together with example translations that Cloud Translation uses to tailor its responses, so machine output matches your own style, tone and domain terminology. You can pass up to five example pairs inline, or create a dataset from which Cloud Translation automatically selects the five reference sentences most similar to your source sentence.

benchmarks.suite_name: Artificial Analysis · Text to Video Arena

docs.text: Aion-2.0 is a variant of DeepSeek V3.2 optimized for immersive roleplaying and storytelling. It is particularly strong at introducing tension, crises, and conflict into stories, making narratives feel more engaging....

Aion-3.0 is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the GLM family of models. It uses a collaborative generation process in which multiple specialized models each contribute...

Aion-3.0 Mini is a multi-model roleplaying and storytelling system from AionLabs, built on the DeepSeek family of models. It uses a collaborative generation process in which multiple specialized models each...

Aion-RP-Llama-3.1-8B ranks the highest in the character evaluation portion of the RPBench-Auto benchmark, a roleplaying-specific variant of Arena-Hard-Auto, where LLMs evaluate each other’s responses. It is a fine-tuned base model...

Runway's precise video editing model, which takes an existing video plus text or image direction and returns an edited video. It matches input resolution, handles clips up to about 30 seconds and pairs with Gen-4.5 for professional output formats such as ProRes and 10-bit SDR.

Amazon Translate is a text translation service that uses advanced machine learning technologies to provide high-quality translation on demand. You can use it to translate unstructured text documents or to build applications that work in multiple languages, from company-authored content and interpersonal communications to incoming social and news feeds.

Apertus-70B-Instruct-2509 is the 70-billion-parameter instruction-tuned model of the Swiss AI Initiative's fully open Apertus family — open weights, open data and documented methodology — trained on 15 trillion tokens of compliant data with a staged web, code and maths curriculum. It supports over 1000 languages and tool use.

Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 is the 8-billion-parameter member of the Swiss AI Initiative's fully open Apertus family, a lighter alternative to the 70B model with the same architecture, multilingual coverage of over 1000 languages and training on 15 trillion tokens of consent-respecting data.

Apertus v1.5 70B is the large model of the Swiss AI Initiative's open-source Apertus 1.5 family, pretrained on 17 trillion tokens and multimodal: it accepts images, audio and text and generates text, with an optional thinking mode that improves reasoning performance.

Apertus v1.5 8B is the small model of the Swiss AI Initiative's open-source Apertus 1.5 family, pretrained on 19 trillion tokens; like the 70B it accepts images, audio and text, generates text and offers an optional thinking mode for reasoning tasks.

Atom is Argil's AI-avatar video model: you give it a text script and an avatar, and the avatar speaks exactly what you write. Argil recommends it for clear, controlled messaging, in contrast to its prompt-driven VEO option which improvises the scene.

Vidu Audio 1.0 is Vidu's text-to-audio model: given a text prompt of up to 1,500 characters it generates an audio clip of 2 to 10 seconds, covering sound effects and background music, through the text2audio endpoint.
A 0.6B-parameter multilingual text-to-speech model with zero-shot voice cloning, supporting 11 languages.

Aura-1 is Deepgram's first-generation text-to-speech model, converting written text into natural-sounding spoken audio via an API request that names a voice. It offers 12 English voices spanning American, British and Irish accents, and has since been succeeded by Aura-2.

Phone Agent is a mobile intelligent assistant framework built on AutoGLM, capable of understanding smartphone screens through multimodal perception and executing automated operations to complete tasks.
The system controls devices via ADB (Android Debug Bridge), uses a vision-language model for screen understanding, and leverages intelligent planning to generate and execute action sequences.

Users can simply describe tasks in natural language—for example, “Open Xiaohongshu and search for food recommendations.”
Phone Agent will automatically parse the intent, understand the current UI, plan the next steps, and carry out the entire workflow.

The system also includes:

Sensitive action confirmation mechanisms
Human-in-the-loop fallback for login or verification code scenarios
Remote ADB debugging, allowing device connection via WiFi or network for flexible remote control and development
Avatar III is HeyGen's v3 rendering engine built around a dedicated photo-to-video pipeline, with a higher-quality re-engineered model for photo avatars and video avatars.
Avatar IV is the default HeyGen v3 rendering engine, offering the broadest avatar support, arbitrary image animation, a motion_prompt and expressiveness control.
Avatar V is HeyGen's highest-fidelity v3 rendering engine, using cross-reference-driven animation for the most natural motion and lip-sync, and is opted into per look.
Aya Expanse 32B is Cohere's highly performant 32B multilingual model, designed to rival monolingual performance across the languages it serves.
Aya Expanse 8B is Cohere's highly performant 8B multilingual model serving 23 languages. It is scheduled for retirement on 4 April 2026.

Baichuan-M2 is a medically-enhanced reasoning model specifically designed for real-world medical reasoning tasks. We begin with real-world medical questions and conduct reinforcement learning training based on a large-scale verifier system. While maintaining the model's general capabilities, the medical effectiveness of Baichuan-M2 has achieved breakthrough improvements.

Baichuan-M2 is currently the world's best open-source medical model. On the HealthBench Benchmark, it surpasses all open-source models, including GPT-OSS-120B, as well as many cutting-edge closed-source models. It is the open-source model closest to GPT-5 in terms of medical capabilities.

Our research demonstrates that a robust verifier is crucial for aligning model capabilities with real-world applications, and an end-to-end reinforcement learning approach fundamentally enhances the model's medical reasoning abilities. The release of Baichuan-M2 represents a significant advancement in the field of medical artificial intelligence, pushing t

Beatoven.ai's composition service generates original, royalty-free background music from a text description of the music that fits your content, using the company's own maestro model. Tracks are delivered with a licence that permits monetisation and can be downloaded as MP3 or WAV.

Bielik-11B-v3.0-Instruct is an 11-billion-parameter multilingual generative model from SpeakLeash and ACK Cyfronet AGH, instruction-tuned from Bielik-11B-v3 on over 20 million instructions and aligned with DPO-Positive and GRPO reinforcement learning. It is optimised above all for Polish while supporting 32 European languages, and takes ChatML-formatted prompts.

Bria 3.2 is the next-generation commercial-ready text-to-image model. With just 4 billion parameters, it provides exceptional aesthetics and text rendering, evaluated to be on par to leading open-source models, and outperforming other licensed models.

Bria 3.2 is the next-generation commercial-ready text-to-image model. With just 4 billion parameters, it provides exceptional aesthetics and text rendering, evaluated to be on par to leading open-source models, and outperforming other licensed models.
Cinematic Avatar is HeyGen's camera-directed avatar video type, layering multi-shot prompts, cinematic motion and scene direction on top of avatar speech.

Claude 3 Haiku is Anthropic's fastest, most compact model for near-instant responsiveness. It answers simple queries and requests with speed. Customers will be able to build seamless AI experiences that mimic human interactions. Claude 3 Haiku can process images and return text outputs, and features a 200K context window.

Claude 3.7 Sonnet was Anthropic's flagship model at release and the first hybrid reasoning model on the market, combining fast standard responses with an optional extended thinking mode. It shows particularly strong improvements in coding and front-end web development and is tuned for real-world business tasks rather than competition problems.
Claude Fable 5 is a Mythos-class model with robust safeguards. It can handle long-running, complex, and asynchronous tasks where previous models would have needed more frequent check-ins.

In addition, it is suited for difficult coding tasks and agentic workflows, especially those with computer use and tool use, and can effectively handle context usage and external memory files.

docs.text: Opus 4.6 is the world’s best model for coding and professional work, built to power agents that take on whole categories of real-world work. It excels across the entire SDLC, breaking through on hard problems, identifying complex bugs, and demonstrating deeper codebase understanding. It also delivers a step-change in knowledge work, with near-production-ready documents, presentations, and spreadsheets on the first pass.

Opus 4.7 builds on the coding and agentic strengths of Opus 4.6 with stronger performance on complex, multi-step tasks and more reliable agentic execution. It also brings improved performance on knowledge work, from drafting documents to building presentations and analyzing data.

Opus 4.8 is a focused upgrade to Opus 4.7 and is Anthropic's best generally available model for coding, agentic tasks, and enterprise workflows. It builds on the strengths of previous Opus models with stronger performance on complex, multi-step coding tasks. Anthropic recommends using it on long-horizon coding and agentic tasks. It is also stronger on professional work, including document drafting, data analysis, and presentations.

Claude Opus 5 is the latest model in Anthropic's Opus family and a step-change improvement over Opus 4.8. It delivers major gains over Opus 4.8 in agentic coding, professional knowledge work, and long-horizon reasoning, and it is stronger per token across effort levels.

Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic’s flagship model for demanding reasoning, coding, and long-horizon agentic work. It is particularly strong at end-to-end software tasks, code review and bug finding, visual analysis...

Claude Sonnet 4.6 is the most capable Sonnet-class model yet, with frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work. It excels at iterative development, complex codebase navigation, end-to-end project management with memory, polished document creation, and confident computer use for web QA and workflow automation.

Sonnet 5 is an upgrade to Sonnet 4.6, with gains across agentic coding and professional work. It builds on the strengths of previous Sonnet models, bringing top-tier intelligence at Sonnet pricing for coding, agents, and everyday professional work at scale.

The Neural Machine Translation model is Cloud Translation's default translation engine, translating text between supported languages through the Cloud Translation API. It handles plain text and HTML, translating only the text that appears between tags and leaving the HTML tags themselves untouched.

CoBuddy is a specialized code generation model developed by Baidu, engineered with targeted optimizations for Coding and AI Agent scenarios. It delivers exceptional performance, characterized by high inference throughput and ultra-low end-to-end (E2E) latency.

Rime's flagship text-to-speech model, combining an LLM backbone with a dedicated speech inference engine trained on full-duplex conversational data. It covers nine languages, emits word-level timestamps for text-audio alignment and interruption handling, and is Rime's recommended starting point for new applications.
Mistral's cutting-edge language model for code completion, released end of July 2025, specializing in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM) and code generation.

Mistral's cutting-edge language model for coding released end of July 2025. Codestral specializes in low-latency, high-frequency tasks such as fill-in-the-middle (FIM), code correction and test generation.

Mistral Codestral Embed is specially designed for code, perfect for embedding code databases, repositories, and powering coding assistants with state-of-the-art retrieval.
codex-mini-latest is a fast reasoning model, a fine-tuned version of o4-mini made specifically for use in the Codex CLI; for direct API use OpenAI recommends starting with gpt-4.1.
code-gecko is the code completion model of the Vertex AI Codey APIs, released generally available alongside code-bison for code generation and codechat-bison for code chat.
A video generation model that "features new frame generation capabilities that significantly improve image stability and clarity", handling dynamic subjects and realistic or 3D-style scenes.
image + text + start and end frame

"CogView-4 is Z.AI's first open-source text-to-image model", with improved semantic understanding, image quality and bilingual Chinese/English text rendering for marketing, e-commerce, games and education.

Command is Cohere's instruction-following conversational model that performs language tasks with high quality.

docs.text: Command A is Cohere's most performant model to date, excelling at tool use, agents, retrieval augmented generation (RAG), and multilingual use cases. Command A has a context length of 256K, only requires two GPUs to run, and has 150% higher throughput compared to Command R+ 08-2024.

Cohere's command-a-plus-05-2026, "the last model in the Command A family" and "Cohere's first Mixture of Experts model" (25B active / 218B total), with vision input, agentic, reasoning, and world-class translation across 48 languages.

docs.text: command-r-08-2024 is an update of the [Command R](/models/cohere/command-r) with improved performance for multilingual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and tool use. More broadly, it is better at math, code and reasoning and...
Command R 03-2024 is Cohere's instruction-following conversational model that performs language tasks at a higher quality, aimed at retrieval-augmented generation and tool use.

command-r-plus-08-2024 is an update of the [Command R+](/models/cohere/command-r-plus) with roughly 50% higher throughput and 25% lower latencies as compared to the previous Command R+ version, while keeping the hardware footprint...
Command R+ 04-2024 is Cohere's larger instruction-following conversational model, best suited for complex RAG workflows and multi-step tool use.
Command R7B (12-2024) is a small, fast update of the Command R+ model, delivered in December 2024. It excels at RAG, tool use, agents, and similar tasks requiring complex reasoning...
Command-light is a smaller, faster version of Cohere's Command model — almost as capable, but a lot faster.

Composer 2.5 is Cursor's own coding model, which Cursor describes as a substantial improvement in intelligence and behavior over Composer 2: it is better at sustained work on long-running tasks, follows complex instructions more reliably, and is more pleasant to collaborate with. It was trained with reinforcement learning on programming problems and synthetic coding tasks.

Contextual GLM v2 is version 2 of Contextual AI's Grounded Language Model, an LLM engineered specifically to prioritise faithfulness to in-context retrievals over parametric knowledge in order to reduce hallucinations in RAG and agentic applications.
Contextual Parse is Contextual AI's document parsing component, which parses a file into structured Markdown and/or JSON for downstream retrieval and generation.
Cosmos3 Super Reasoner is a 33B reasoning-focused model from NVIDIA, optimized for complex reasoning and multi-agent AI tasks.
Uncensored and creative writing model based on Mistral Small 3.2 24B with good recall, prompt adherence, and intelligence.

Databricks DBRX appears in current Databricks docs only in retirement tables: "DBRX / DBRX Instruct" retired from Foundation Model APIs pay-per-token on 2025-04-30 and provisioned throughput on 2025-12-19. No description or context window is given.

DPT-2 is LandingAI's second-generation Document Pre-Trained Transformer, the model behind Agentic Document Extraction's Parse API: it identifies document layouts and chunks and generates descriptive captions for those chunks. It adds agentic table captioning with cell-level grounding, refined figure and logo captioning, smarter layout detection on poor scans, and recognition of attestations such as signatures, stamps and seals, ID cards, barcodes and QR codes.

DPT-3 Fast is the speed-oriented of the two Document Pre-Trained Transformer models that power LandingAI's ADE Parse, which converts documents into accurate machine-readable formats with layout preserved and precise citations. It returns Markdown and JSON with a document hierarchy of pages, elements, table cells and visual lines plus bounding boxes and confidence scores.

DPT-3 Pro is LandingAI's flagship Document Pre-Trained Transformer parsing model and the default for ADE Parse, converting PDFs, scans and images into accurate machine-readable Markdown and JSON with layout preserved. It returns a document hierarchy of pages, elements, table cells and visual lines together with a spatial grounding map, bounding boxes and confidence scores.

DeepL's text-translation API consists of a single translate endpoint that submits UTF-8 plain text (up to 128 KiB per request) for translation between DeepL's supported languages, returning translations in the order requested. It supports source-language detection, glossaries, formality levels and formatting preservation.

The speech-to-speech mode of DeepL's Voice API, which transcribes and translates spoken audio in real time over a WebSocket connection and additionally returns synthesized speech in the target language alongside the translated text.

The speech-to-text mode of DeepL's Voice API, which transcribes and translates spoken audio in real time over a WebSocket connection. From one audio stream you receive transcripts in the source language and translations as text in multiple target languages of your choice.

The DeepL Write API improves text within a single language rather than translating it: /write/rephrase fixes spelling and grammar and may rewrite sentences for clarity, style or tone, while /write/correct runs a corrections-only pass that fixes spelling and grammar with minimal changes to wording. Writing style and tone parameters steer how the improved text sounds.

DeepSeek-Prover-V2, an open-source large language model designed for formal theorem proving in Lean 4, with initialization data collected through a recursive theorem proving pipeline powered by DeepSeek-V3. The cold-start training procedure begins by prompting DeepSeek-V3 to decompose complex problems into a series of subgoals. The proofs of resolved subgoals are synthesized into a chain-of-thought process, combined with DeepSeek-V3's step-by-step reasoning, to create an initial cold start for reinforcement learning.
We introduce DeepSeek-R1, which incorporates cold-start data before RL. DeepSeek-R1 achieves performance comparable to OpenAI-o1 across math, code, and reasoning tasks.

DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B is a high-performance reasoning model based on the Qwen3 8B Base model, enhanced through the integration of DeepSeek-R1-0528's Chain-of-Thought (CoT) optimization. In the AIME 2024 evaluation, this open-source model achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, delivering a 10% improvement over the original Qwen3 8B while matching the reasoning capabilities of the much larger 235-billion-parameter Qwen3-235B-thinking.

DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 14B is a distilled large language model based on Qwen 2.5 14B, using outputs from DeepSeek R1. It outperforms OpenAI's o1-mini across various benchmarks, achieving new state-of-the-art results for dense models.

Other benchmark results include:

AIME 2024 pass@1: 69.7
MATH-500 pass@1: 93.9
CodeForces Rating: 1481
The model leverages fine-tuning from DeepSeek R1's outputs, enabling competitive performance comparable to larger frontier models.

DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B is a distilled large language model based on Qwen 2.5 32B, using outputs from DeepSeek R1. It outperforms OpenAI's o1-mini across various benchmarks, achieving new state-of-the-art results for dense models.  Other benchmark results include:  AIME 2024: 72.6 | MATH-500: 94.3 | CodeForces Rating: 1691.

DeepSeek-V3 is the latest model from the DeepSeek team, building upon the instruction following and coding abilities of the previous versions. Pre-trained on nearly 15 trillion tokens, the reported evaluations reveal that the model outperforms other open-source models and rivals leading closed-source models.
DeepSeek-V3.1-Terminus delivers more stable & reliable outputs across benchmarks compared to the previous version and addresses user feedback (i.e. language consistency and agent upgrades).

docs.text: DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp is an intermediate step toward the next-generation architecture of the DeepSeek models by introducing DeepSeek Sparse Attention—a sparse attention mechanism designed to explore and validate optimizations for training and inference efficiency in long-context scenarios.

DeepSeek‑V3.2 from DeepSeek harmonizes high computational efficiency with superior reasoning and agent performance. It builds on three main techniques: DeepSeek Sparse Attention for long‑context efficiency, a scalable reinforcement learning framework, and a large‑scale agentic task synthesis pipeline. This model excels at long-context reasoning and agentic tasks, efficiently handling extended inputs while maintaining strong accuracy. Its sparse attention design enables it to process complex, multi-step workflows without excessive compute costs. Overall, DeepSeek‑V3.2 targets long‑context reasoning, tool‑using agents, and efficient deployment in production environments.

DeepSeek V4 Flash is an efficiency-focused MoE model with 284B total parameters (13B active) and a 1M-token context window. It's tuned for fast inference and high-throughput use cases while still holding up on reasoning and coding tasks.

This model excels at long-context reasoning and agentic tasks, efficiently handling extended inputs while maintaining strong accuracy. Its sparse attention design enables it to process complex, multi-step workflows without excessive compute costs. Overall, DeepSeek‑V3.2 targets long‑context reasoning, tool‑using agents, and efficient deployment in production environments.

DeepSeek-OCR as an initial investigation into the feasibility of compressing long contexts via optical 2D mapping. DeepSeek-OCR consists of two components: DeepEncoder and DeepSeek3B-MoE-A570M as the decoder. Specifically, DeepEncoder serves as the core engine, designed to maintain low activations under high-resolution input while achieving high compression ratios to ensure an optimal and manageable number of vision tokens. Experiments show that when the number of text tokens is within 10 times that of vision tokens (i.e., a compression ratio < 10x), the model can achieve decoding (OCR) precision of 97%. Even at a compression ratio of 20x, the OCR accuracy still remains at about 60%. This shows considerable promise for research areas such as historical long-context compression and memory forgetting mechanisms in LLMs.

DeepSeek-OCR 2 is a multimodal document recognition model released by DeepSeek AI, serving as an upgrade to DeepSeek-OCR. By introducing the DeepEncoder V2 architecture, it achieves a paradigm shift in visual encoding from "fixed scanning" to "semantic reasoning." The model replaces the original CLIP encoder with a lightweight language model (Qwen2-0.5B) and incorporates a causal flow query mechanism, while retaining the DeepSeek-3B-MoE decoder. The model requires only 256 to 1120 visual tokens to cover complex document pages. On the OmniDocBench v1.5 benchmark, it achieves an overall score of 91.09%, a 3.73% improvement over its predecessor, with reading order recognition edit distance reduced from 0.085 to 0.057.

docs.text: DeepSeek-R1 provides customers a state-of-the-art reasoning model, optimized for general reasoning tasks, math, science, and code generation.
The DeepSeek R1 model has undergone a minor version upgrade, with the current version being DeepSeek-R1-0528.
The DeepSeek R1 0528 turbo model is a state of the art reasoning model that can generate very quick responses

DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B is an 8B model based on Llama-3.1-8B and fine-tuned on reasoning traces generated by DeepSeek-R1, demonstrating that reasoning patterns of larger models can be distilled into smaller ones. It targets mathematics, coding and general problem solving and emits detailed reasoning chains.

DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is a 7B model built on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and fine-tuned on 800,000 samples generated by DeepSeek-R1, distilling the larger model's reasoning patterns into a compact architecture. It is used for text generation, mathematical problem solving, coding and general reasoning.

DeepSeek-V3, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token. To achieve efficient inference and cost-effective training, DeepSeek-V3 adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures, which were thoroughly validated in DeepSeek-V2.
DeepSeek-V3-0324, a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters with 37B activated for each token, an improved iteration over DeepSeek-V3.

DeepSeek-V3.1 is post-trained on the top of DeepSeek-V3.1-Base, which is built upon the original V3 base checkpoint through a two-phase long context extension approach, following the methodology outlined in the original DeepSeek-V3 report. We have expanded our dataset by collecting additional long documents and substantially extending both training phases. The 32K extension phase has been increased 10-fold to 630B tokens, while the 128K extension phase has been extended by 3.3x to 209B tokens. Additionally, DeepSeek-V3.1 is trained using the UE8M0 FP8 scale data format to ensure compatibility with microscaling data formats.

DeepSeek-V3.2-Speciale is the API-only, maximum-reasoning variant released alongside DeepSeek-V3.2. DeepSeek says it rivals Gemini-3.0-Pro and has taken gold-level results at IMO, CMO, the ICPC World Finals and IOI 2025; it dominates complex tasks but uses more tokens, supports only thinking mode and does not support tool calls.

This is a trusted-execution-environment deployment of DeepSeek-V3.2, DeepSeek's 685B-parameter language model that balances computational efficiency with advanced reasoning and adds "thinking with tools". Its key innovations are DeepSeek Sparse Attention for long-context efficiency, a scalable reinforcement learning framework and a large-scale agentic task synthesis pipeline.

This is a trusted-execution-environment deployment of deepseek-v4-flash, the fast tier of DeepSeek's V4 family, currently at the 0731 snapshot. It supports both non-thinking and thinking (default) modes, JSON output and tool calls, and is API-compatible with both the OpenAI and Anthropic formats.

The Deliberate Model allows for the creation of anything desired, with the potential for better results as the user's knowledge and detail in the prompt increase. The model is ideal for meticulous anatomy artists, creative prompt writers, art designers, and those seeking explicit content.
Mistral's frontier code-agent model for solving software engineering tasks; it excels at using tools to explore codebases, editing multiple files and powering software engineering agents.

Devstral is an agentic LLM for software engineering tasks, making it a great choice for software engineering agents.

Upstage Document Classify sorts an input document into one of your own user-defined categories, working across scanned images, photographs and born-digital PDFs with no templates and no fine-tuning, so it can be used to route documents into the right downstream extraction schema.

Upstage Document OCR detects and recognises text in a wide range of document images with high accuracy across languages and image qualities, staying robust on rotated pages, watermarks, noise and checkboxes, and supports Hangul and Hanja as well as low-quality scans.

Upstage Document Parse automatically converts any document into structured text such as HTML or Markdown. It detects layout elements including paragraphs, tables and images, serialises them in reading order and outputs structured text for RAG pipelines, document QA and automation.

Doubao-Seed-1.6-lite is ByteDance's compact deep-thinking model on Volcengine Ark, launched as the strongest small-size reasoning model in the Seed 1.6 line with a large speed-up in inference over doubao-seed-1-6.

Doubao-Seed-1.6-vision is Doubao's visual thinking model, offering stronger general multimodal understanding and reasoning than doubao-1-5-vision-pro in scenarios such as education, image moderation, inspection and security, and AI search Q&A. It supports deep thinking, GUI task handling, tool calling and structured output.

Doubao-Seed-2.1-pro is the Pro tier of ByteDance Seed's Seed 2.1 family, a next-generation agent model for real-world productivity covering project planning, file processing and tool use, with strengthened end-to-end delivery in code engineering. It handles text, images, documents, charts and video, and performs strongly on long-context benchmarks.

Seed-Evolving is the Seed-series model built for Agent and Coding scenarios, with complex task orchestration, long-horizon planning, code generation and tool-calling abilities. It ships on a dynamic iteration mechanism with at least one new version a week, and is always called through the single model ID doubao-seed-evolving so you get the latest version without switching endpoints.

Doubao-Seed-character is ByteDance's role-play model for entertainment scenarios, with strengthened plot reasoning, dialogue pacing and emotional progression, plus human-like natural chat, thinking, and multimodal understanding of video, images and stickers. It can proactively start a conversation and reply in context, and supports format following and function/tool calling.

docs.text: Doubao-Seed-code is the programming model in ByteDance's Doubao Seed line on Volcengine Ark: a deep-thinking model with enhanced coding capability that supports both thinking and non-thinking modes alongside multimodal understanding and tool calling.

doubao-seed-translation is ByteDance's in-house multilingual translation model, built on a 7B multilingual text foundation model trained from scratch. It translates between 28 languages and is meant to shed the stilted 'translationese' of small models in favour of faithful, idiomatic and fluent output.

Seed3D 2.0 is ByteDance Seed's next-generation 3D generative model, producing high-precision geometry and unified PBR materials from a single image and extending to scene layout planning, part-aware decomposition and training-free articulation. Its simulation-ready output is aimed at physics and graphics engines, embodied AI and industrial use.

Seedance 1.0 is ByteDance Seed's video generation model supporting multi-shot video generation from both text and image, creating 1080p videos with smooth motion, rich details and cinematic aesthetics. It maintains visual consistency across shots and handles complex action sequences and camera movements.

Doubao-Seedance-1.0-pro-fast is a video generation model that strikes an excellent balance between generation quality, speed and cost. It supports text-to-video and first-frame image-to-video at 480p, 720p or 1080p, 24 fps, for clips of 2-12 seconds.

One of the three Doubao Seedance 2.0 video models; Volcengine recommends Seedance 2.0 Fast when you want to balance cost and generation speed and do not need the very highest quality. Like the rest of the series it accepts image, video, audio and text input and covers text-to-video, first- and last-frame image-to-video, omni-modal reference-to-video, video editing and video extension at 480p or 720p, 24 fps, 4-15 seconds.

One of the three Doubao Seedance 2.0 video models; Volcengine recommends Seedance 2.0 Mini when the priority is lowest cost. It supports the same feature set as the rest of the series - text-to-video, first- and last-frame image-to-video, omni-modal reference-to-video, video editing and video extension - at 480p or 720p, 24 fps, 4-15 seconds.

Doubao-Seedance-2.5 is ByteDance Seed's next-generation joint audio-video generation model built for 30-second storytelling, letting a single generation run up to 30 seconds and be extended twice. It accepts large numbers of image, video and audio references, supports timestamp-level editing, green screen and camera-perspective control, and can drive pacing and lip-sync from an audio track across 10+ languages.

docs.text: Seedream-5.0-Pro, ByteDance's newest image generation model, delivers comprehensive upgrades for complex, lifelike image creation and editing, ushering in a new phase of controllable visual production. It stands out with precise editing control, robust commercial applicability and natural rendering results.

Doubao-embedding-vision is ByteDance's multimodal embedding model. It converts mixed input of text, images and video into a unified vector representation so you can process cross-modal data efficiently and run accurate text-to-image, image-to-image and combined text-image search, with dense, sparse and multi-vector output types depending on version.

docs.text: The ERNIE 4.5 series of open-source models adopts a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, representing an innovative multimodal heterogeneous model structure. It achieves cross-modal knowledge fusion through a parameter-sharing mechanism while retaining dedicated parameter spaces for individual modalities. This architecture is particularly well-suited for the continuous pre-training paradigm from large language models to multimodal models, significantly enhancing multimodal understanding capabilities while maintaining or even improving performance in text-based tasks. The models are efficiently trained, inferred, and deployed using the PaddlePaddle deep learning framework. During the pre-training of large language models, the Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) reaches 47%. docs.text: ERNIE-4.5-21B-A3B-Thinking is a text-based Mixture of Experts (MoE) post-training model featuring 21B total parameters with 3B active parameters per token. It delivers enhanced performance on reasoning tasks, including logical reasoning, mathematics, science, coding, text generation, and academic benchmarks that typically require human expertise. The model offers efficient tool utilization capabilities and supports up to 128K tokens for long-context understanding.

ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-128K is the long-context member of Baidu's ERNIE 4.5 Turbo text generation family on Qianfan, aimed at long document understanding and multi-turn conversation. It accepts up to 128k tokens of context and produces up to 12,288 output tokens.

ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-32K is the 32k-context text generation model in Baidu's ERNIE 4.5 Turbo family on the Qianfan platform, offering the family's general instruction-following and reasoning ability at a shorter context length. It produces up to 12,288 output tokens.

ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-VL-32K is the vision-language variant of Baidu's ERNIE 4.5 Turbo family on Qianfan, accepting both text and images and returning text. It supports a 32k-token context and up to 12,288 output tokens.

ERNIE-X1.1 is Baidu's dedicated reasoning model on Qianfan, built on the ERNIE 4.5 multimodal foundation with an iterative hybrid reinforcement learning and self-distillation framework, and upgraded on factuality, instruction following and agentic capability. It offers a 64k-token context with extended chain-of-thought reasoning.

EVI 3 is Hume AI's speech-to-speech foundation model, which the company calls the world's most realistic and instructible speech-language model. It listens to a user's speech and replies with expressive, emotionally aware speech, and lets developers create custom voices by prompting rather than picking from preset speakers.

Flash v2.5 is ElevenLabs' "fast, affordable speech synthesis model" for latency-sensitive text-to-speech, with ultra-low latency (~75ms), 32 languages, a 40,000 character limit and "50% lower price per character".
Text content plus a voice selection; up to 40,000 characters per request.
Audio in MP3, PCM (S16LE), μ-law and Opus formats.

Eleven Multilingual v2 is ElevenLabs' high-quality speech synthesis model producing natural-sounding speech with high emotional range and contextual understanding across 29 languages. It is recommended for character voiceovers, professional content, multilingual projects and audiobooks, and accepts up to 10,000 characters per request.

Eleven Music is ElevenLabs' generative music model that creates original studio-quality instrumental or vocal tracks from a natural-language description. Users control genre, style and structure and can edit the sound and lyrics of individual sections or the whole song.

ElevenLabs text-to-speech "turns text into lifelike audio with nuanced intonation, pacing and emotional awareness"; Eleven v3 is "Our most emotionally rich, expressive speech synthesis model", Multilingual v2 a "Lifelike, consistent quality speech synthesis model".
Text content plus a voice selected from the voice library; Eleven v3 has a 5,000 character limit and 70+ languages, Multilingual v2 a 10,000 character limit and 29 languages.
Audio in multiple formats including MP3 (22.05kHz-44.1kHz), PCM (S16LE) (16kHz-44.1kHz), μ-law and Opus.

Solar Embedding 1 Large is Upstage's Solar-based embedding model, released as paired query and passage variants with a 4k context limit: the query model is optimised for embedding a user's question and the passage model for embedding documents to be searched. It is deprecated in favour of Solar Embedding 2.

Solar Embedding 2 is Upstage's current embedding pair (solar-embedding-2-query and solar-embedding-2-passage), fine-tuned from microsoft/harrier-oss-v1-0.6b, with an 8k context limit and 1,024-dimensional vectors for semantic search, clustering and multilingual retrieval.
A model that allows for text, images, or mixed content to be classified or turned into embeddings.

Embedding-V1 is Baidu's text embedding model on the Qianfan platform, generating a vector representation of input content for similarity search, clustering, recommendation and classification. Each text is limited to 384 tokens and 1,000 characters, with up to 16 texts per request.

A text embeddings API that "uses dense vector representations" designed "to better represent the meaning of a piece of text", so you can search for passages that align to a query's meaning rather than word matches.

Dense numeric vectors — "gemini-embedding-001, for example, uses 3072-dimensional vectors". "The vectors are normalized, so you can use cosine similarity, dot product, or Euclidean distance to provide the same similarity rankings."

Speechmatics' highest-accuracy speech-to-text operating point for single-language audio, available in batch and realtime. Speechmatics suggests it for demanding work such as medical, legal and subtitling, with an Enhanced Medical variant for healthcare terminology.

FIBO Lite is the smaller, faster, Docker-ready variant of Bria's JSON-native text-to-image model FIBO, intended for on-premises and local deployment. It keeps FIBO's controllability, prompt adherence and structured generation with minimal quality degradation.

Flux is Deepgram's conversational speech recognition model built specifically for voice agents rather than passive transcription: it understands conversational flow and automatically handles turn-taking. It offers model-integrated end-of-turn detection, configurable turn-taking dynamics and ultra-low latency at Nova-3 level accuracy, in English-only and 10-language variants.

FLUX 3 is Black Forest Labs' latest model family for video generation, exposed through a single endpoint that supports text-to-video, image-to-video from keyframes, video continuation from an existing clip's final frames, and full-quality rendering of a previously generated draft. Clips run 5 to 20 seconds at HD or FHD with optional synchronized multilingual audio, speech and effects.

FLUX.1 Redux [dev] is an image variation generation adapter for all FLUX.1 base models. It enables users to refine images with slight variations and supports text-based restyling via API. Integrated with FLUX1.1 [pro] Ultra, it allows for high-quality 4-megapixel outputs. The model can be used with Diffusers in Python for efficient image generation. While powerful, it has ethical and factual limitations and is governed by a non-commercial license.

FLUX.1 Fill [pro] is Black Forest Labs' image inpainting model: it takes an input image plus a black-and-white mask (or an embedded alpha mask) and a text prompt, and regenerates only the white masked areas according to the prompt. Options cover generation steps, guidance strength and output format.
Premium FLUX.1 Kontext tier for text-to-image and context-aware editing, featuring "industry-leading typography" and "maximum prompt adherence" when output excellence matters more than speed.

FLUX.1 Kontext [pro] is Black Forest Labs' image creation and editing model, which takes a text prompt plus up to four reference images and either generates a new image or edits the supplied ones. It is now a legacy model, with FLUX.2 [pro] recommended for new integrations.

FLUX.1-dev is a state-of-the-art 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer developed by Black Forest Labs. This model excels in text-to-image generation, providing highly accurate and detailed outputs. It is particularly well-regarded for its ability to follow complex prompts and generate anatomically accurate images, especially with challenging details like hands and faces.

FLUX.1 [pro] is Black Forest Labs' professional text-to-image model, described as a robust and proven baseline for generating high-quality visuals from written descriptions. It combines fast inference with strong prompt adherence and is available through the BFL API for embedding into pipelines and apps.

FLUX.1 [schnell] is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of generating images from text descriptions. This model offers cutting-edge output quality and competitive prompt following, matching the performance of closed source alternatives. Trained using latent adversarial diffusion distillation, FLUX.1 [schnell] can generate high-quality images in only 1 to 4 steps.

FLUX.1 Kontext [dev] is a 12-billion-parameter image editing model that transforms visuals based on natural language instructions. It allows highly consistent, multi-step edits and is released with open weights under a non-commercial license to empower artists and researchers.

Brand-new Flux2 Dev introduces a faster, more modular architecture for next-generation image generation pipelines. It delivers improved performance, cleaner control APIs, and a significantly more flexible development workflow for custom inference setups.

Hy-MT2-Plus is Tencent Cloud Hunyuan’s 7B translation model, offering an 8K-token context window and broad multilingual coverage. Optimized for translation across 33 languages and five ethnic Chinese and dialect variants, it delivers industry-leading performance on benchmarks including FLORES-200 and WMT25. It excels in professional domains and real-world business scenarios, with strong instruction-following for structured, delimiter-preserving, context-aware, glossary-guided, and style-specific translation.

Hy-MT2-Pro is Tencent Cloud Hunyuan’s flagship translation model, featuring 30B-A3B parameters and an 8K-token context window. It delivers bidirectional translation across 33 core language pairs, plus five minority-language and dialect pairs. With industry-leading performance on FLORES-200 and WMT25, it excels in specialized domains and real-world business scenarios while supporting structured, contextual, terminology-aware, style-specific, and delimiter-preserving translation.

Hy-Role is the role-playing model in Tencent's TokenHub Hunyuan catalogue, built to fit a wide range of personas and to act out storylines. Tencent lists a 32k context window with 28k maximum input and 4k maximum output.

Built for real-world business scenarios, Hy3 features a 295B/21B active MoE architecture, native 256K context support, and three reasoning modes. It enhances coding, long-form comprehension, multi-turn dialogue, and agentic task execution, balancing reliability, efficiency, and cost across both high-frequency interactions and complex workflows.

Ideogram 1.0 is the first major generation of Ideogram's text-to-image model, released in February 2024 and now listed by Ideogram as a legacy model that remains selectable by its legacy API model value. It has been superseded by the 2.x, 3.0 and 4.0 generations.

Ideogram 2.0 is Ideogram's August 2024 text-to-image model, described by the company as a frontier model with industry-leading capabilities in generating realistic images, graphic design and typography. Its launch also brought the Ideogram iOS app, the beta API and Ideogram Search; Ideogram now lists it as the older 2.x model.
Ideogram 2a is the faster model in Ideogram's 2.x text-to-image generation, exposed in the API as model value V_2_1. Ideogram states that 2a renders faster than 2.0 at equivalent rendering settings.

Ideogram 3.0 is the March 2025 text-to-image model that Ideogram calls the release that turned image generation into something creative teams could use for campaigns, brand systems and polished design work. It combines photorealism, legible text rendering and Style References — uploading images or reusing style codes to steer aesthetics — and is strong on text-heavy designs such as posters, logos and brand assets.

docs.text: Ideogram's newest generation model for professional design work, built for "prompt fidelity, crystal-clear type, reliable editing, native transparency, style control, and design-quality outputs" across app, API, MCP, and open weights.
text prompt + optional reference image + aspect ratio settings

Imagen 2 is Google's text-to-image technology on Vertex AI, generating high-quality, photorealistic, high-resolution images from natural language prompts, with text rendering, logo generation, captioning and visual question answering.

The Imagen 3 models generate and edit images using text and visual inputs; the generate variants (imagen-3.0-generate-002/001) turn text prompts into images with digital watermarking and configurable safety settings.

imagen-3.0-fast-generate-001 is the Imagen 3 fast generation variant that generates images from text prompts, optimized for lower latency, with digital watermarking and user-configurable safety settings.
Imagen 4 is Google's latest line of image generation models, a high-fidelity text-to-image model capable of generating realistic and high quality images from text prompts.

docs.text: imagen-4.0-ultra-generate-001 is the highest-quality Imagen 4 variant, generating images from text prompts at resolutions up to 2816x1536 with digital watermarking and Content Credentials support.
imagen-4.0-fast-generate-001 is the faster Imagen 4 endpoint for text-to-image generation, producing PNG or JPEG images with lower latency at resolutions up to 1408x768.
imagen-4.0-generate-001 is the standard Imagen 4 model, balancing quality and speed to generate up to 4 images per text prompt at resolutions up to 2816x1536.

Imagen product recontext lets you generate images of products in different scenes or backgrounds: you provide an image of a product and a prompt, and it generates images of your product in new scenes.
Virtual Try-On lets you generate virtual try-on images from an image of a person and product photos that you provide.
Imagen visual captioning (imagetext@001) uses the Imagen model to get a short, general description of a supplied image.
Imagen Visual Q&A (imagetext@001) uses the Imagen model to ask a question and get an answer about a supplied image.

Upstage Information Extract performs schema-free key information extraction from any document type — complex PDFs, scans and Office files — without templates or fine-tuning, dynamically producing structured output for a supplied schema and inferring implied values such as totals derived from line items.

Ink 2 is Cartesia's production speech-to-text model, described as the world's fastest and most accurate streaming speech-to-text model with native turn detection that senses when speakers begin and finish speaking. Audio is streamed to it and transcripts come back in real time, at around 100 ms transcript latency.

Ink Whisper is Cartesia's most economical speech-to-text model, transcribing audio with better performance than baseline Whisper. It handles variable-length audio chunks and interruptions with dynamic chunking, copes with background noise, telephony artifacts, accents and disfluencies, and covers over 100 languages.
Inkling is a multimodal MoE model (975B total, 41B active, 256k context) reasoning over text, image, and audio inputs.
Inkling-Small is a lighter-weight model with 12B active parameters, trained with a similar recipe, to Inkling that achieves strong performance with even lower cost and latency.

Interfaze is an AI model built on a new architecture that merges specialized DNN/CNN models with LLMs for developer tasks that require deterministic output and high consistency like OCR, scraping, classification, STT and more.

Isaac 0.1 is Perceptron's first perceptive-language model, a 2B-parameter open-weights vision-language model aimed at systems that understand and interact with the physical world. Perceptron says it matches or beats models many times its size on core perception, excelling at visual question answering, in-context learning of new visual concepts from a few annotated examples, OCR, and grounding with precise pointing and localization.

Isaac 0.2 1B is Perceptron's compact 1B-parameter hybrid-reasoning vision-language model, adding optional reasoning via thinking traces, perceptive tool calling including the Focus zoom-and-crop system, stronger grounding, better OCR, better desktop use and improved structured output. Perceptron targets robotics, media search and industrial inspection, with the model deployable on commodity GPUs or edge devices.

Isaac 0.2 2B Preview is the 2B-parameter hybrid-reasoning vision-language model in Perceptron's Isaac 0.2 family, released as an open-weights preview for edge and low-latency deployment. It supports reasoning via thinking traces, perceptive tool calling with the Focus zoom-and-crop system, stronger grounding, better OCR, desktop and UI understanding, and reliable structured JSON output.

Janus-Pro is a novel autoregressive framework that unifies multimodal understanding and generation. It addresses the limitations of previous approaches by decoupling visual encoding into separate pathways, while still utilizing a single, unified transformer architecture for processing. The decoupling not only alleviates the conflict between the visual encoder’s roles in understanding and generation, but also enhances the framework’s flexibility. Janus-Pro surpasses previous unified model and matches or exceeds the performance of task-specific models. The simplicity, high flexibility, and effectiveness of Janus-Pro make it a strong candidate for next-generation unified multimodal models.

Juggernaut Lightning Flux is RunDiffusion's speed-oriented text-to-image model: "Using the power of Flux Schnell, this mode is blazing fast and insanely powerful", with some providers generating it in under 300ms.
Generated image; a drop-in replacement for Flux Schnell trained non-destructively on the Flux architecture.

Juggernaut Pro Flux is RunDiffusion's flagship text-to-image model in the Juggernaut FLUX series: it "boosts realism, especially in people, surpassing Flux 1.1 Pro and other flagship models in this category".
Generated image, with "enhanced sharpness, colors, skin tone, reduced blur, and overall improved visual aesthetics"; a drop-in replacement for Flux 1.1 Pro.
A drop-in replacement for Flux [Dev] that delivers sharper details, richer colors, and enhanced realism, while instantly boosting LoRAs and LyCORIS with full compatibility.

KAT-Coder-Pro V2 by KwaiKAT is a non-reasoning model optimized for agentic coding. It delivers strong performance on reasoning-style tasks while requiring significantly fewer output tokens than peer models. With the 1210 release, it achieved a score of 64 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, placing it in the global Top 10 and ranking first among all non-reasoning models.
Fast response version of Kat Coder V2.5 optimized for Agent and Claw use cases.
A high-performance edition designed for complex enterprise projects and SaaS integration.
KAT-Coder-V2.5 is a coding-focused agentic model trained to act autonomously inside real, executable repositories rather than as a single-turn code generator.

KAT-Coder-Pro V1 is KwaiKAT's most advanced agentic coding model in the KwaiKAT series. Designed specifically for agentic coding tasks, it excels in real-world software engineering scenarios, achieving a remarkable 73.4% solve rate on the SWE-Bench Verified benchmark. KAT-Coder-Pro V1 delivers top-tier coding performance and has been rigorously tested by thousands of in-house engineers. The model has been optimized for tool-use capability, multi-turn interaction, instruction following, generalization and comprehensive capabilities through a multi-stage training process, including mid-training, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), and scalable agentic RL.

docs.text: Kimi K2 is a state-of-the-art mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. Trained with the Muon optimizer, Kimi K2 achieves exceptional performance across frontier knowledge, reasoning, and coding tasks while being meticulously optimized for agentic capabilities.

Kimi K2 0905 is the September update of Kimi K2 0711. It is a large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model developed by Moonshot AI, featuring 1 trillion total parameters with 32 billion active per forward pass. It supports long-context inference up to 256k tokens, extended from the previous 128k.  This update improves agentic coding with higher accuracy and better generalization across scaffolds, and enhances frontend coding with more aesthetic and functional outputs for web, 3D, and related tasks. Kimi K2 is optimized for agentic capabilities, including advanced tool use, reasoning, and code synthesis. It excels across coding (LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench), reasoning (ZebraLogic, GPQA), and tool-use (Tau2, AceBench) benchmarks. The model is trained with a novel stack incorporating the MuonClip optimizer for stable large-scale MoE training.

Kimi K2 is a large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model developed by Moonshot AI, featuring 1 trillion total parameters with 32 billion active per forward pass. It is optimized for agentic capabilities, including advanced tool use, reasoning, and code synthesis. Kimi K2 excels across a broad range of benchmarks, particularly in coding (LiveCodeBench, SWE-bench), reasoning (ZebraLogic, GPQA), and tool-use (Tau2, AceBench) tasks.

docs.text: Kimi K2 Thinking is an advanced open-source thinking model by Moonshot AI. It can execute up to 200 – 300 sequential tool calls without human interference, reasoning coherently across hundreds of steps to solve complex problems. Built as a thinking agent, it reasons step by step while using tools, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Humanity's Last Exam (HLE), BrowseComp, and other benchmarks, with major gains in reasoning, agentic search, coding, writing, and general capabilities.

docs.text: Kimi-K2.7-Code is a coding model from Moonshot AI. It has  improved coding & agent performance over K2.6, more reasoning efficiency with less overthinking, and improved instruction following for long-horizon coding.

Kimi K2.7 Code HighSpeed is the high-speed version of Kimi K2.7 Code, the same model as Kimi K2.7 Code, but with an output speed of approximately 180 Tokens/s and up to 260 Tokens/s in short context scenarios, delivering a more extreme coding experience.
Kimi’s flagship model for long-horizon coding and end-to-end knowledge work, with a 1M-token context window.

Kling 1.0 (API model kling-v1) is the first-generation Kling video model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It accepts text, image and video input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P, with camera-control and other single-shot generation features.

Kling 1.5 (API model kling-v1-5) is a Kling video generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It accepts text, image and video input and produces 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P; unlike Kling 1.0 and 1.6 it does not support plain text-to-video single-shot generation.

Kling 1.6 (API model kling-v1-6) is a Kling video generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It accepts text, image and video input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P.

Kling 2.0 Master (API model kling-v2-master) is the flagship model of Kling's 2.0 video generation line on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text or image input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 1080P.

Kling 2.1 is a generation of Kuaishou's Kling video model released in May 2025 as a lineup of Standard, Pro and Master tiers, emphasizing higher fidelity at 1080p/30fps for text-to-video and image-to-video generation.

Kling 2.1 Master is the top tier of Kuaishou's KLING 2.1 lineup, which ships in Standard, Pro and Master versions; Master is the highest-quality option for text-to-video and image-to-video generation at 1080p.

Kling 2.5 Turbo (API model kling-v2-5-turbo) is a video generation model in Kuaishou's Kling API line-up, which Kling summarizes as maximum creativity at exceptional value; the 2.5 generation added longer, more cinematic shots with realistic physics at reduced cost and turnaround.

Kling 2.5 Turbo (API model kling-v2-5-turbo, called in pro mode) is a Kling video model that Kuaishou sums up as max creativity with exceptional value. It takes text or image input and generates 5-second or 10-second clips at 720P or 1080P.

Kling VIDEO 2.6 is Kling's first native-audio video model: instead of generating silent visuals and adding sound later, it produces visuals, natural voice, action sound effects and ambient atmosphere together in a single pass. It supports speech, dialogue, narration, singing, rap and mixed sound effects, and also adds Motion Control for transferring motion from a video to an image.

docs.text: Kling VIDEO 3.0 builds on Kling VIDEO O1 and VIDEO 2.6 with a deeply integrated unified training framework that merges Native Audio with Element Consistency control and breaks through duration limits, generating up to 15 seconds of native audio-visual output. It adds Multi-Shot storyboard control, precise text rendering, stronger subject consistency and more accurate semantic response, and supports native 4K output.

docs.text: Kling VIDEO 3.0 Omni is the unified multimodal member of the Kling 3.0 series, the upgrade of VIDEO O1: images, videos, elements and text you upload are all treated as prompts, and the model understands any combination of them to generate the video. Omni also adds Voice as an element, binding a specific voice to a character so they look and sound the same across scenes and shots.

Kling 3.0 Turbo is the speed-oriented member of the Kling 3.0 series, described by Kling as faster and more reliable at scale and built for high-volume pipelines, with reduced end-to-end latency, precise audio-visual sync and consistently strong output quality.

Kling Image 1.0 (API model kling-v1) is the first-generation image model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text and image input and generates 1K images in aspect ratios from 21:9 through 1:1 to 9:16.

Kling Image 1.5 (API model kling-v1-5) is an image generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text and image input and generates 1K images across the platform's eight supported aspect ratios.

Kling Image 2.0 (API model kling-v2) is an image generation model on Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform. It takes text and image input and generates images at 1K or 2K resolution across the platform's eight supported aspect ratios.
Kling IMAGE 2.1 is a generation of Kuaishou's Kling text-to-image model, which Kling characterizes by superb prompt adherence and reliable output.

Kling IMAGE 3.0 supports natural-language image creation together with reference images, style transfer, portrait and character reference, multi-image blending and local re-editing in one flexible image workflow. It can extract features from up to 10 reference images, locking in subject contours and core elements to keep generated images consistent.

Kling IMAGE 3.0 Omni focuses on cinematic narrative stills and richer image storytelling, extending Kling's image workflow with Image Series Mode and direct 2K/4K Ultra HD model output for finer texture rendering and smoother colour transitions.

Kling IMAGE O1 is Kling's unified visual creation image model, built on a new engine and described by Kling as a versatile AI visual creation tool that enables efficient creative realization through precise control and diverse capabilities.

Kling VIDEO O1 integrates diverse video tasks into a single unified architecture — reference-based generation, text-to-video, start/end-frame interpolation, video inpainting, transformation, stylization and extension — so editing and generation happen in one model. Instead of manual masking or keyframing, users prompt changes such as removing bystanders, changing daytime to dusk or replacing an outfit, and can combine several tasks in one prompt, generating 3-10 second clips.

Kling Video v3 [pro] is the professional-quality tier of Kuaishou's Kling VIDEO 3.0 model, which generates up to 15-second clips with native audio, multi-shot storyboard control, precise text rendering and strong element consistency, with native 4K output available.

Krea recommends Large for photorealism, raw textures and motion blur — the richest output — at slower speed than Medium.

Krea 2 Medium is the general-purpose variant of Krea 2, Krea's first from-scratch foundation image model, giving stable everyday output at standard generation speed. Krea recommends it for illustration, anime, painting and expressive artistic styles, with the same style references, moodboards and Generative Sliders as Large.

Unlike LTX-2.3 Pro it does not support audio-to-video.

LTX-2.3 Pro is the full-featured model of Lightricks' LTX-2.3 family, generating up to 4K video with synchronized audio from text, image or audio input and supporting editing operations such as retake, extend and reframe.

LTX-2 is a DiT-based audio-video foundation model designed to generate synchronized video and audio within a single model. It brings together the core building blocks of modern video generation, with open weights and a focus on practical, local execution.

Poolside's open-weight mixture-of-experts model with 225B total and 23B activated parameters, built for agentic coding and long-horizon work. Laguna S 2.1 is Poolside's new open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon work.

Ling-3.0-flash is a 124B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, with approximately 5.1B parameters activated per token.
The model is designed with token efficiency and production-scale agentic inference as key priorities, enabling developers to complete more useful work within constrained token, latency, and serving-cost budgets.

Ling 3.0 Flash is designed with token efficiency and production-scale agentic inference as key priorities, enabling developers to complete more useful work within constrained token, latency, and serving-cost budgets.

A 70-billion-parameter Meta Llama 3 auto-regressive language model using an optimized transformer with Grouped-Query Attention, intended for commercial and research use in English, in pretrained and instruction-tuned chat variants.

An 8-billion-parameter Meta Llama 3 auto-regressive language model, pretrained and instruction-tuned, intended for commercial and research use in English, with instruction-tuned versions built for assistant-like chat and pretrained ones for natural language generation.
Meta developed and released the Meta Llama 3 family of large language models (LLMs), a collection of pretrained and instruction tuned generative text models in 8 and 70B sizes.

An update to Meta Llama 3 70B Instruct that includes an expanded 128K context length, multilinguality and improved reasoning capabilities.

Llama 3.2 11B Vision is a multimodal model with 11 billion parameters, designed to handle tasks combining visual and textual data. It excels in tasks such as image captioning and visual question answering, bridging the gap between language generation and visual reasoning. Pre-trained on a massive dataset of image-text pairs, it performs well in complex, high-accuracy image analysis.  Its ability to integrate visual understanding with language processing makes it an ideal solution for industries requiring comprehensive visual-linguistic AI applications, such as content creation, AI-driven customer service, and research.
The Meta Llama 3.2 collection of multilingual large language models (LLMs) is a collection of pretrained and instruction-tuned generative models in 1B and 3B sizes (text in/text out).

Where performance meets efficiency. Euryale L3.3 70B is a model focused on creative roleplay from [Sao10k](https://ko-fi.com/sao10k). It is the successor of [Euryale L3 70B v2.2](/models/sao10k/l3-euryale-70b).
As a general purpose LLM, Llama 4 Maverick contains 17 billion active parameters, 128 experts, and 400 billion total parameters, offering high quality at a lower price compared to Llama 3.3 70B.

Llama 4 Maverick 17B Instruct (128E) is a high-capacity multimodal language model from Meta, built on a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with 128 experts and 17 billion active parameters per forward pass (400B total). It supports multilingual text and image input, and produces multilingual text and code output across 12 supported languages. Optimized for vision-language tasks, Maverick is instruction-tuned for assistant-like behavior, image reasoning, and general-purpose multimodal interaction.

Maverick features early fusion for native multimodality and a 1 million token context window. It was trained on a curated mixture of public, licensed, and Meta-platform data, covering ~22 trillion tokens, with a knowledge cutoff in August 2024. Released on April 5, 2025 under the Llama 4 Community License, Maverick is suited for research and commercial applications requiring advanced multimodal understanding and high model throughput.

Llama 4 Scout is the best multimodal model in the world in its class and is more powerful than our Llama 3 models, while fitting in a single H100 GPU. Additionally, Llama 4 Scout supports an industry-leading context window of up to 10M tokens.

Llama 4 Scout 17B Instruct (16E) is a mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model developed by Meta, activating 17 billion parameters out of a total of 109B. It supports native multimodal input (text and image) and multilingual output (text and code) across 12 supported languages. Designed for assistant-style interaction and visual reasoning, Scout uses 16 experts per forward pass and features a context length of 10 million tokens, with a training corpus of ~40 trillion tokens.

Built for high efficiency and local or commercial deployment, Llama 4 Scout incorporates early fusion for seamless modality integration. It is instruction-tuned for use in multilingual chat, captioning, and image understanding tasks. Released under the Llama 4 Community License, it was last trained on data up to August 2024 and launched publicly on April 5, 2025.

Llama Guard 3 11B Vision is Meta's multimodal safety classifier: it evaluates the prompt text and the image together to decide whether a prompt is safe, using the vision understanding of Llama 3.2 11B-Vision. It answers safe or unsafe and, when unsafe, lists the violated hazard categories (S1-S13); it is optimized for English text and handles one image per prompt.

Llama Guard 4 is a natively multimodal safety classifier with 12 billion parameters trained jointly on text and multiple images. Llama Guard 4 is a dense architecture pruned from the Llama 4 Scout pre-trained model and fine-tuned for content safety classification. Similar to previous versions, it can be used to classify content in both LLM inputs (prompt classification) and in LLM responses (response classification). It itself acts as an LLM: it generates text in its output that indicates whether a given prompt or response is safe or unsafe, and if unsafe, it also lists the content categories violated.

Llama Prompt Guard 2 22M is the smaller of Meta's two BERT-based prompt-attack classifiers, trained on a large corpus of attacks to detect both prompt injections in untrusted inputs and explicitly malicious jailbreak prompts. It takes any string and returns a benign or malicious label; the 22M variant focuses on English and is meant for latency- or resource-constrained deployments.

Llama Prompt Guard 2 86M is Meta's full-size BERT-based prompt-attack classifier, trained on a large corpus of English and non-English attacks to detect prompt injections and jailbreaks. It takes any string and returns a benign or malicious label, requiring no particular prompt structure or configuration.

docs.text: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano is an open reasoning model optimized for fast, cost-efficient inference. Built with a hybrid MoE and Mamba architecture and trained on NVIDIA-curated synthetic reasoning data, it delivers strong multi-step reasoning with stable latency and predictable performance for agentic and production workloads.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super is a 120B-parameter open hybrid MoE model, activating just 12B parameters for maximum compute efficiency and accuracy in complex multi-agent applications. It delivers up to 7x higher throughput, providing fast, cost-efficient inference for agentic tasks. Additionally, a long context window gives the model long-term memory, preventing AI agents from losing focus on long, multi-step tasks and ensuring high-accuracy results. Fully open with weights, datasets, and recipes, Super allows easy customization and secure deployment anywhere.

docs.text: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super is a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model engineered for highest compute efficiency and accuracy in multi-agent applications and specialized agentic systems. It is optimized to run many collaborating agents per application on a single GPU, delivering high accuracy for reasoning, tool use, and instruction following.
A 550B parameter (55B active) open reasoning model from NVIDIA, built for long-running agent workflows. It uses a hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE architecture and supports a 1M token context window.

NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4 is a large language model (LLM) trained by NVIDIA.

The model employs a hybrid Mixture-of-Experts architecture, utilizing interleaved Mamba-2 and MoE layers, along with select Attention layers. The Lightning 3.5 model is released alongside a number of speculative decoding methods for faster text generation. The model has 3B active parameters and 30B parameters in total.

The model is an auto-regressive vision language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture. The model enables multi-image reasoning and video understanding, along with strong document intelligence, visual Q&A and summarization capabilities.

NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 is a large language model (LLM) trained from scratch by NVIDIA, and designed as a unified model for both reasoning and non-reasoning tasks. It responds to user queries and tasks by first generating a reasoning trace and then concluding with a final response. The model's reasoning capabilities can be controlled via a system prompt. If the user prefers the model to provide its final answer without intermediate reasoning traces, it can be configured to do so.\

Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 is a compact multilingual text embedding model from NVIDIA, pruned and distilled from Ministral-3 to ~1B parameters, that maps text into 2048-dimensional dense vectors for retrieval and semantic similarity. Spanning 34 languages, it delivers state-of-the-art quality among similarly sized models for RAG and multilingual question-answering while keeping compute cost low.

Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-NVFP4 is the NVFP4-quantized version of Nemotron-3-Embed-1B-BF16 — a multilingual text embedding model from NVIDIA that maps text into 2048-dimensional dense vectors for retrieval and semantic similarity. Optimized for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs (e.g. RTX 6000 PRO, GB200), it retains near-BF16 quality (RTEB 72.0 vs 72.4) at a fraction of the memory and compute.

Nemotron-3-Embed-8B is a multilingual text embedding model from NVIDIA, based on Ministral-3-8B, that maps text into 4096-dimensional dense vectors for retrieval and semantic similarity. Spanning 34 languages, it targets multilingual RAG and question-answering over large corpora and achieves state-of-the-art results on the RTEB leaderboard.

Qwen3-TTS is an advanced text-to-speech model by Alibaba's Qwen team, delivering stable, expressive, and low-latency speech generation across 10 languages.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           Key capabilities:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  - 9 preset voices — Vivian, Serena, Uncle_Fu, Dylan, Eric, Ryan, Aiden, Ono_Anna, Sohee — covering diverse genders, ages, and accents                                                                                                              - Voice cloning — clone any voice from a short (~3s) audio sample via the voice_id parameter   - Instruction control — adjust tone, emotion, and speaking style with natural language (e.g. "speak slowly and calmly", "excited tone")   - 10 languages — English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese   - Streaming support — real-time PCM streaming with ~97ms first-byte latency   - Multiple output formats — WAV, MP3, FLAC, PCM    Built on a 1.7B parameter architecture using discrete multi-codebook language modeling for end-to-end speech synthesis without cascading errors. Uses a custom 12Hz acoustic tokenizer that preserves paralinguistic information and   environmental audio details.

● Qwen3-TTS-VoiceDesign is a voice design variant of Qwen3-TTS by Alibaba's Qwen team. Instead of selecting from preset voices, you describe the voice you want in natural language — and the model generates speech in that voice.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Key capabilities:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  - Natural language voice control — describe any voice with free text (e.g. "a deep male voice with a calm, authoritative presence", "a young cheerful female with a warm and friendly tone")   - 10 languages — English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese                                                                                                                                         - Streaming support — real-time PCM streaming   - Multiple output formats — WAV, MP3, FLAC, PCM    Built on the same 1.7B parameter architecture as Qwen3-TTS, using discrete multi-codebook language modeling and a custom 12Hz acoustic tokenizer for high-quality end-to-end speech synthesis.

Whisper is a state-of-the-art model for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation, proposed in the paper "Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision" by Alec Radford  et al. from OpenAI. Trained on >5M hours of labeled data, Whisper demonstrates a strong ability to generalise to many datasets and domains in a zero-shot setting. Whisper large-v3-turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large-v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4. As a result, the model is way faster, at the expense of a minor quality degradation.

Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multi-task model that can perform multilingual speech recognition as well as speech translation and language identification.
