docs.text: Tavily Search is a search engine built for LLM agents: the /search endpoint takes a query and returns relevance-ranked web results with title, URL and content snippets, plus an optional LLM-generated answer, with filtering by domain, country, language and date.

attrs.coverage: any page it is pointed at

docs.text: ADE Classify is LandingAI's document classification API: it assigns each page of a document to a class you define in natural language, so you can build page routers before parsing. It returns per-page labels with a reason field describing the page, marks unclassified pages as unknown, needs no fine-tuning or templates, and works in English and 20+ languages.

Hive's AI Audio Classifier takes an audio file as input and determines whether or not that audio is AI-generated, so platforms can immediately identify and tag artificial audio clips. It returns confidence scores for the ai_generated and not_ai_generated classes, splitting longer clips into timestamped 10-second segments.
HeyGen AI Clipping turns a long-form video into short highlight clips via POST /v3/ai-clipping, with target durations, portrait, landscape or square framing, and virality scores.

A Hive endpoint that runs two models over an image to flag artificially created or manipulated media: AI-generated detection returns ai_generated / not_ai_generated plus the likely generator (DALL-E, Midjourney, Sora and other popular AI art generators) and any C2PA metadata, while deepfake detection returns a confidence score for each detected face.

Synthesia's AI video generator turns text prompts, scripts, documents, slide decks or URLs into studio-quality presenter-led video without filming, using a library of 240+ AI avatars and voiceovers in 160+ languages. Output is exported as MP4, shareable links or SCORM packages for enterprise LMS use.

The video form of Hive's AI-generated content detection: it scans video frames to identify AI-generated and deepfake footage, returning generation and source classifications with confidence scores. Hive positions it for flagging AI-generated content on social platforms, preventing fraud in claims evidence, and limiting misinformation and digital sexual assault.

An AI reviewer run on Lingo.dev: automated evaluation using an independent LLM, performed after each translation. Every reviewer attached to an engine runs on every translation request and works asynchronously, so it never slows the translation response down.
A Runway API recipe that localizes an ad image for a target language while preserving the visual creative, swapping the copy without redoing the design.

Meshy's Animation API applies a chosen animation action from Meshy's library to a previously rigged 3D character, with optional post-processing such as frame-rate change, format conversion and armature extraction. It takes a completed rigging task ID and an action ID and returns downloadable animated models in GLB, FBX and USDZ.

Tripo Animation Retarget applies a preset animation to an already-rigged 3D model, choosing one or several presets from a library of 90+ biped motions (walk, dance, jump and so on) plus a smaller set for other body types, and returns the animated model.

Exa's Answer endpoint runs an Exa search and returns an LLM-generated response informed by the results, giving a direct answer for specific factual queries or a detailed summary with citations for open-ended research questions.

The Brave Answers API provides AI-generated answers backed by verifiable sources from the web, powering Brave's Ask Brave feature. It supports a fast single-search mode and a multi-search research mode, returns inline citations and usage metadata, streams responses and is OpenAI SDK compatible.

Astra is Topaz Labs' creative video model: a diffusion-based upscaler that takes AI-generated footage to 4K while generating new detail, with an adjustable creative-intensity parameter. Because it adds detail it can change objects, identity and stylisation, and it runs only in the cloud.

Hive's speech moderation API, built on top of its speech-to-text and text moderation models, detects undesirable speech inside audio or video. It returns a fully punctuated transcript with per-word confidence and timestamps plus moderation scores for the Sexual, Violence, Hate and Bullying classes.

Tripo Auto Rig automatically adds a skeleton rig to a 3D model supplied as a task id, file token or public URL (GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ or STL up to 150 MB), covering biped characters as well as quadruped, hexapod, octopod, avian, serpentine and aquatic creatures, and returns a rigged GLB or FBX.
Meshy's Rigging (auto-rigging) API automatically generates a skeletal structure for a 3D character so it can be animated; a successful rigging task is the prerequisite for Meshy's Animation API.

Hive AutoML Image Classification lets you train custom image classification models on your own dataset to categorize images and videos, starting from either an Image Classification or a Visual Moderation base model. Typical uses are object classification, brand identification and vision moderation.

Hive AutoML Text Classification lets you train custom text classification models that predict a category or class for a piece of text content, choosing among general-purpose, moderation and sentiment base models. It is aimed at content moderation, topic labelling and sentiment analysis.

The Brave Autosuggest API delivers query autocompletion and search suggestions as users type, adapted to their location and language. It can enrich suggestions with titles, descriptions and images, detect entities such as people or places, and tolerate typos.

Azure AI Content Safety is an AI service that detects harmful user-generated and AI-generated content in applications and services, with text and image APIs for spotting sexual, violent, hate and self-harm material at multiple severity levels. It also includes Prompt Shields, groundedness detection, protected material detection and custom categories, and an interactive Content Safety Studio.

Bria's background generation route replaces the background of any image, generating a new backdrop around the preserved foreground subject. It is part of Bria's image editing suite of specialised endpoints.

Ideogram's Background Remover strips the background from an image and returns a transparent PNG with a clean alpha channel, preserving fine details such as edges, text, hair and glass; the background can also be replaced with a generated scene from a prompt. The API endpoint POST /v1/remove-background accepts JPEG, PNG and WebP files up to 10 MB and is built for high-volume catalogue and product-listing work.

Veryfi's Bank Checks OCR API reads the front and back of a cheque image and returns structured JSON: MICR routing, account and serial numbers, cheque number, amount, date, payer and payee, bank details, signature and endorsement detection, plus X9.37 and ACH compliance formats and fraud signals.

Veryfi's Bank Statements OCR API uses machine learning to read printed or handwritten bank statements in any language or currency and convert them into structured JSON — account holder and bank details, opening and closing balances and itemised transactions with categories — for reconciliation, loan verification and fraud detection.

Amazon Bedrock Guardrails provides configurable safeguards to help you build safe generative AI applications, detecting and filtering undesirable content and protecting sensitive information in user inputs or model responses. It bundles content filters, denied topics, word filters, sensitive information filters, contextual grounding checks and Automated Reasoning checks, and can be applied during model inference or standalone through the ApplyGuardrail API.

Bloom is Topaz Labs' family of creative image models that creatively upscale AI-made images up to 8x with optional text prompts steering the added detail. It prioritises the look over strict fidelity and can alter objects, identity and stylisation.
Bria's Remove BG route removes the background of an image, isolating the foreground subject. It is one of the endpoints in Bria's image editing suite.

A Browserbase session is a managed, isolated headless browser instance from Browserbase's global fleet that lets an agent interact with websites the way a human would, including JavaScript rendering, login flows and interactive elements. Browserbase describes itself as the complete platform for building and deploying agents that browse and interact with the web.

Hive's Celebrity Recognition API detects the presence of well-known figures in images, combining face detection and face-similarity models with a continuously updated index of over 50,000 figures. For each detected face it returns a bounding box, the person's name, a confidence score and a category such as politician, athlete, religious leader or celebrity.

Chunkr Extract auto-fills custom schemas from documents: given a document and a user-defined schema it returns structured JSON with the extracted values, citations showing where each value came from and confidence scores.

Chunkr Parse turns any document into LLM-ready data, converting PDFs, spreadsheets and images into machine-readable output such as markdown together with bounding boxes giving the location of each element.

Classify is the LlamaIndex product that routes documents into categories using natural-language rules, letting you label and dispatch incoming files before further processing. It is one of the six composable products of the LlamaParse platform, alongside Parse, Extract, Split, Sheets and Index.

Browser Use's Cloud Browser lets you launch a hosted browser and connect to it from your own code: it returns a Chrome DevTools Protocol URL so tools such as Playwright or Puppeteer can drive the browser directly, rather than delegating the work to an agent.

A sandboxed code-execution tool for models: Code Interpreter "adds the capability to safely execute code in an isolated container", and is "practical to draw graphs, data analysis, mathematical operations, code validation, and much more".
Code written by the agent, run inside an isolated container as a built-in tool of the agent.
The executed code plus "The output of the executed code" (code_output) returned with execution metadata.

Stability AI's Conservative Upscaler, which takes images between 64x64 and 1 megapixel and upscales them roughly 20-40x up to a 4 megapixel output with minimal alteration to the original. Stability says it minimises changes and should not be used to reimagine an image.

The purpose of Hive's Contextual Scene Classification is to identify the context of visual content, chiefly for content-based ad targeting. For each image or sampled video frame it returns confidence scores across settings, subjects, objects and the IAB Content Taxonomy.
Firecrawl's Crawl recursively traverses a website and gathers the content of every discovered page, giving complete site-wide coverage rather than isolated page fetches.
Recraft's creative upscale tool, which enhances a given raster image by boosting resolution with a focus on refining small details and faces.

Stability AI's Creative Upscaler, an asynchronous service that upscales highly degraded images below 1 megapixel all the way to 4K with a creative twist, reimagining detail under a creativity control. Stability notes it is not for photos of 1MP or above because it performs heavy reimagining.
Recraft's crisp upscale tool, which enhances a given raster image by increasing its resolution and making the image sharper and cleaner.

Data extraction is one of the per-page capabilities Writer bills for Knowledge Graph, its graph-based retrieval-augmented generation service: it pulls the structured content out of files added to a Knowledge Graph so they can be indexed and queried. Writer prices it at $0.00015 per page.

Exa Deep is Exa's agentic search tier, using optimised query expansion and LLM reasoning for high-quality results, and its Agent API performs asynchronous multi-step web research, list-building and enrichment with natural-language answers, structured outputs and citations.
Ideogram's Describe generates a text description from an uploaded or generated image, turning a picture back into a prompt-like caption.

Resemble AI's real-time multimodal deepfake detection system, built to stop deepfakes before they cause damage. It takes audio, video and image files through an API and returns a detection verdict with forensic detail in under 300 milliseconds.

Document Translation translates formatted documents such as PDF and DOCX directly, preserving the original formatting and layout in the translated output. It supports DOC/DOCX, PDF, PPT/PPTX and XLS/XLSX, in both online single-file and batch modes, and works with custom models and glossaries.
Reducto's document editing endpoint, which fills PDF forms and modifies DOCX files programmatically with natural language instructions, returning the updated document.
Eleven Sound Effects (Text to Sound v2) generates sound effects from a text description of the desired sound. It is language-agnostic and aimed at games, media production and multimedia projects.
Stability AI's Erase service, which removes unwanted objects — such as blemishes on portraits or items on desks — using image masks supplied explicitly or derived from the image's alpha channel.
Recraft's erase-region endpoint, which removes specified regions of an image using a grayscale mask in which white pixels mark the areas to erase.
Bria's Eraser route removes elements or specific areas from a given image while preserving the rest of the composition. It is part of Bria's image editing endpoints.

A separately billed Patronus output: most evaluators also return explanations, human-readable reasoning for why they gave a particular score, so you understand not just what the score is but why your output received it.

FIBO's structured prompt capability converts a short natural-language prompt into a machine-readable JSON schema that specifies every visual factor of the intended image. Because the schema can be versioned, automated and integrated into agentic workflows, it gives developers precise, reproducible control over generation.

FLUX Deblur is a Black Forest Labs FLUX Tools endpoint that regenerates a blurry image with a dedicated blur-removal model, sharpening it while preserving the original scene, objects, composition and lighting. No prompt is needed — the model applies a fixed blur-removal pass to the whole image.

FLUX Erase is a Black Forest Labs FLUX Tools endpoint that removes objects or regions from an image using a black-and-white mask, where white pixels mark the object to remove and black pixels are preserved. A dilate_pixels option expands the mask by up to 25 pixels to cover object edges.

FLUX Outpainting places the input image on a larger canvas at a given offset and generates the surrounding region with a FLUX outpainting model, optionally guided by a text prompt. Its default "high" mode prioritises highest-fidelity detail and consistency, while a "fast" mode trades fidelity in the extended regions for speed.

FLUX VTO is Black Forest Labs' virtual try-on endpoint, generating an image of a person wearing supplied garments from a person image, one or more garment images and a text prompt that steers attribute transfer. Reference and output resolution are supported up to 4MP.

Stability AI's Fast Upscaler, which enhances image resolution by 4x using predictive and generative AI. It is a lightweight service processing in about a second, aimed at improving compressed images for social posts and similar uses.

File parsing (OCR) is the Knowledge Graph capability that reads scanned and image-based files added to a Writer Knowledge Graph so their text can be indexed for retrieval. Writer prices it at $0.055 per page.
HeyGen Filler Word Removal strips filler words such as "um" and "uh" and overlong silences from a finished video via POST /v3/filler-word-removals, returning one cleaned cut plus statistics.
Tripo Convert Format turns a 3D model into another format — GLTF, FBX, USDZ, OBJ, STL or 3MF — with optional mesh processing, UV packing, texture baking, symmetry enforcement and animation export.

Bria's GenFill route generates objects by prompt inside a specified region of an image, synthesising new content in the designated area from a text description. It is part of Bria's image editing suite.

Topaz's generative enhancement models (the Wonder family for images) improve quality by adding recovered detail and texture while preserving the original image intent, restoring low-quality photographs in a single step and offering generative face recovery.

Gigapixel is Topaz Labs' precision image-enhancement family for upscaling photos, graphics and print while staying faithful to the source, with generative and non-generative face restoration. Eight variants cover cases such as art and CGI, transparent images, low resolution, faces and text.

Grounding model answers in Google Maps data: it "connects the generative capabilities of Gemini with the rich, factual, and up-to-date data of Google Maps" and "enables developers to easily incorporate location-aware functionality into their applications".
A user query with geographical context (e.g. "coffee shops near me"), optionally accompanied by the user's latitude and longitude; the tool is off by default and must be enabled in the request.
"a text response with inline annotations linking to Google Maps sources, allowing developers to display citations"; each annotation includes the place name and a URL to the Maps listing.

Grounding model answers in your own data: responses are anchored to your organization's sources rather than model training data alone, making them factually current and traceable to authoritative sources.
A user prompt plus a configured grounding source: Vertex AI Search (managed enterprise search), RAG-based grounding, Elasticsearch, or a custom search API of your own.
A grounded response with citations / grounding metadata referencing the retrieved source information.
HyperFrames is HeyGen's code-driven video framework that turns HTML compositions into rendered video, built around compositions, data attributes, variables and deterministic rendering.

A Hyperbrowser session is an isolated cloud browser instance that you control programmatically over a WebSocket endpoint compatible with Playwright and Puppeteer. Sessions are used for scraping, testing and agentic web interaction, with configurable stealth, proxy routing, cookies, screen size and timeouts, plus a live view URL.

Resemble AI's biometric verification product, which authenticates individuals by voice and likeness matching. It enrols a speaker from a short voice sample and then verifies later attempts against that identity across applications.

Photoroom's full-featured editing endpoint, which applies edits to an image such as resizing, replacing the background, re-lighting the subject or adding a realistic shadow. It also covers text removal, upscaling and apparel-specific tools like virtual model, flat lay and ghost mannequin.
Bria's Image Expansion route expands an image by generatively extending the canvas and filling in the surrounding content. It is one of Bria's image editing endpoints.

Recraft's image-to-image endpoint, which creates images similar to a given image, preserving certain aspects like composition, colour or subject identity while altering others based on the prompt. A strength parameter controls how far the result departs from the source.

Ideogram's Upscale raises an image to 2X resolution while enhancing colour, detail, text rendering and photorealism and reducing artifacts. It works on Ideogram generations or uploaded images and is steered with resemblance and detail sliders plus an optional prompt.
Bria's Increase Resolution route upscales the resolution of any image, raising its pixel dimensions. It is part of Bria's image editing suite.

Mixedbread's indexing side is built on Stores: you upload PDFs, images, documents, code or video in any format and Mixedbread automatically parses, chunks and embeds them — including text, images, tables and complex layouts across 100+ languages — with no parsing pipeline, embedding model or vector database to manage.
Stability AI's Inpaint service, which modifies images by filling in or replacing specified areas with new content based on the content of a mask image, guided by a prompt.

Recraft's inpainting endpoint, which regenerates specific parts of an image while keeping the rest intact, useful for correcting details, replacing elements or making creative changes. It takes the image, a mask and a prompt.

Ideogram's instructional edit endpoint edits one or more existing images from a natural-language prompt describing the change, without a mask: the scene is preserved and only the prompted change is applied. It accepts up to 10 JPEG, PNG or WebP images by upload or Ideogram URL and returns the edited images.

Resemble AI's explainability layer over Detect, which turns a detection verdict into human-readable forensic analysis identifying which artifacts contribute to scores and why. It produces audit-ready reports in real time for compliance teams and legal reviewers.

Firecrawl's Interact lets you engage with a fetched page through code execution or AI prompts — manipulating elements, filling forms, clicking buttons or asking the browser to take further actions — which is useful for JavaScript-heavy sites and multi-step navigation.

Veryfi's invoice and receipt OCR API converts invoices and bills submitted as images, PDFs or file URLs into machine-readable JSON, extracting vendor details, dates, line items with quantities and prices, taxes, totals and currency for accounts-payable and expense automation.

The Jina Search API (s.jina.ai) searches the web for a query and returns the top results with their page content already converted into LLM-friendly text. Jina positions it as a way to keep an LLM up to date, improve factuality and reduce hallucinations.

Confident AI is an AI quality platform built for enterprise teams to standardize evals and observability across the organization. Its LLM evaluation side offers 50+ research-backed metrics, multi-turn simulation, human metric alignment and CI/CD regression testing, alongside tracing, drift detection, governance gating and OWASP/NIST-based red teaming.

Rev AI's Language Identification API, which provides additional speech insights by identifying the spoken language in an audio file. It returns a list of possible languages ranked by a confidence score between 0 and 1.
₹3.5/10K characters — Rounded up to the nearest character in each request.

The higher-capability tier of Patronus's hosted evaluator API, billed per thousand large evaluator API calls. Patronus evaluators are automated functions that score the quality, safety and performance of your LLM outputs.

Ideogram's Layerize analyzes a flat design and returns the text baked into it as editable layers, each with its string, role, font, colour and position, alongside a text-erased base image. It lets teams localize, rewrite and restyle a design's copy without regenerating the artwork.
Vidu Lip Sync generates lip-synchronised video driven either by text or by an audio track, matching a character's mouth movements to the supplied speech.

HeyGen's Lipsync API dubs or replaces the audio on an existing video and re-syncs the speaker's mouth movements to the new track, running asynchronously via POST /v3/lipsyncs. It offers a Precision mode for frame-accurate mouth movements on long-form, cinematic video and a Speed mode for faster dubbing and localization.

Split is the LlamaIndex product that segments concatenated documents into logical sections: you upload a combined PDF, define categories such as invoices, receipts or cover pages, and get back the page ranges for each document type. It is one of the six composable products of the LlamaParse platform.

LlamaParse is LlamaIndex's agentic OCR and document parsing product, turning PDFs, scans and images into clean markdown, text or JSON; LlamaIndex calls the surrounding platform the enterprise platform for turning documents into production AI pipelines. It handles 130+ formats and is the foundation most document pipelines start from before extraction, classification or indexing.

Hive's Logo Recognition model localizes brand logos in images and video, returning a bounding box, the brand classification, a clarity score representing visible identifiability, and the surface the logo appears on (jersey, helmet, stadium sign and so on). Hive describes it as the world's most comprehensive logo model, covering more than 11,000 logos.

Zapier MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that lets AI assistants and agents take real actions across the 9,000+ apps Zapier integrates with — sending email, updating spreadsheets, scheduling meetings, posting messages — on demand from a natural-language request rather than on a Zap trigger, reusing the app connections the account already has.
Firecrawl's Map takes a website and returns all the URLs on it, extremely fast, giving a complete URL inventory of a site without fetching full page content.

MiniMax's web_search tool performs a web search for a given query and returns structured results — title, URL, snippet and date — along with related search suggestions. It is provided through MiniMax's Token Plan search API and MCP server so coding agents can pull in current information during a task.

An image-generation tool call inside an agent API: "Image Generation is a built-in tool that enables agents to generate images of all kinds and forms", letting a model create images at any point in a conversation.
A text prompt to the agent, e.g. "Generate an orange cat in an office."
A tool_file chunk carrying "a unique identifier for the generated file" (file_id), file_name and file_type "which in this case is png"; the image is then downloaded via the files endpoint.

Mixedbread Search queries a Store with a natural-language question rather than keywords and returns precisely ranked results optimized for AI applications, searching seamlessly across 100+ languages. Mixedbread positions it as a way to give agents verifiable context and reduce hallucinations, accessible via API, CLI and MCP.

Model Armor is a Google Cloud service designed to enhance the security and safety of your AI applications by proactively screening LLM prompts and responses. It helps prevent malicious input, verify content safety, protect sensitive data, maintain compliance and enforce AI safety and security policies, covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, harmful content and malicious URLs.

Firecrawl's Monitor watches web content on a schedule with change detection and alerting — a single page, a whole website, or a continuous web search — and notifies you by webhook or email when something meaningful changes.
A Runway API recipe that generates multi-shot videos that cut between scenes, assembling a sequence of shots from scene descriptions or reference material into one narrative clip.

Hive's OCR model detects and transcribes each word in an image and also returns semantically organized text blocks in natural reading order, with emoji detection across Apple, Samsung and Google devices. It is used for moderating memes and image-based text, spotting contact details and promotional overlays, and pulling structured metadata out of receipts, forms and screenshots.

Mindee's OCR API is the platform's raw-text utility model: it runs optical character recognition over an uploaded document image and returns its content as structured text, and underpins Mindee's extraction models, which combine OCR with visual layout understanding. Mindee describes models as configurable, reusable engines that automate turning unstructured document images into actionable, structured data.

Hive's OCR Moderation is an end-to-end API that provides content moderation for text within images by first extracting all text in the image and passing that information through Hive's text moderation models. It returns text localization, confidence scores across moderation classes, and profanity or pattern matches, and covers twelve languages plus emoji.

Hive's Object Detection API localizes objects of interest in an image by returning a box that bounds each object plus its type, across 80+ supported classes such as person, car and dog. For video, Hive splits the clip into frames, runs the model on each and recombines the results with timestamps.

Ideogram's Object Remover erases an unwanted object from a photo: you brush over the object to make a mask, and the model regenerates the background so shadows, grain and perspective stay consistent with the surrounding scene. It is exposed via POST /v1/remove-object and is used to remove photobombers, watermarks, text, logos and clutter.
Stability AI's Outpaint service, which inserts additional content in an image to fill in the space in any direction, allowing you to zoom out of an image.

Writer's PDF parser endpoint converts PDF documents into other formats, extracting text content for further analysis — for example turning research papers into searchable text or PDF documentation into markdown. Writer has deprecated the endpoint in favour of a prebuilt parsing tool for chat completions.

Second vendor, same service kind: an endpoint that "returns clean, structured content from any URL, handling JavaScript-rendered pages, PDFs, and complex layouts automatically", and can crawl linked subpages in one request.
"A list of URLs to extract content from", plus extract_depth (basic or advanced) and format ("markdown returns content in markdown format. text returns plain text and may increase latency.").
raw_content, "The full content extracted from the page"; optional extracted image URLs; and failed_results, "A list of URLs that could not be processed" with an error message each.
"You pass in URLs and get back full page text, targeted highlights, LLM-generated summaries, or all three" — text mode returns "Full page content as clean markdown".
Reducto's foundational endpoint, which converts documents into structured JSON with text, tables and figures, using layout-aware chunking and agentic OCR across 30+ file types.

web_search is the built-in web search tool of Perplexity's Agent API, letting a model run searches with advanced filtering by domain and date, a configurable number of results (1-50) and a token budget for search context.

A Pika video-to-video model that inserts any subject into an existing video. You supply the source footage, a prompt describing what to add and optionally a reference image of the subject, and it composites the addition into the original clip.

Pika's effects model, which applies playful physics effects — squish, melt, explode, dissolve and around 50 others — to a still image and turns it into a short animated video. It is aimed at cinematic short-form and social content.

A Pika video-to-video model that swaps subjects or objects in a video while keeping the scene. You give it the footage, a prompt, a region described in free text or as a mask, and optionally a reference image of the replacement subject.

The Unstructured Platform is a no-code, pay-as-you-go service for turning unstructured data into retrieval-augmented-generation-ready data. It connects to source systems and runs documents through routing, transformation into a standard JSON schema, chunking, optional image and table enrichment, embedding and persistence to a destination such as a vector database.

Proteus is Topaz Labs' precision video enhancement family, designed to improve resolution, reduce noise and remove compression artefacts without introducing artificial edges or altering the character of the footage. It handles camera, CGI and AI-generated sources from standard definition to 8K and beyond.

Veryfi's Receipts & Invoices OCR API turns receipt documents (JPG, PNG, PDF and more) into structured JSON using foundation models trained on hundreds of millions of receipts, returning over 150 fields — merchant details, dates, line items, taxes, totals, barcodes, fraud indicators and OCR confidence — across 91 currencies and 38 languages.
Recraft's API endpoint that removes the background of a given image, accepting raster or SVG input and returning the subject on transparency.
Reducto's schema-driven extraction endpoint: you pull specific fields into structured JSON using a schema, defining what you need and getting exactly that back from the document.
Reducto's split endpoint, which divides documents into logical sections using natural language descriptions of the sections you want.

Meshy's Remesh API reprocesses an existing 3D model — from a previous Meshy task or a public model URL — and re-exports it with a chosen topology and polygon budget. It supports quad-dominant or decimated triangle meshes, target polycounts from 100 to 300,000, adaptive decimation, and export to GLB, FBX, OBJ, USDZ, Blend, STL and 3MF.
Stability AI's Remove Background service, which accurately segments the foreground from an image and removes the background.

Photoroom's streamlined endpoint for cases where you only need to remove the background from an image and don't need any additional edits. It takes an image and returns the same image with the background cut out.
Recraft's replace-background endpoint, which detects the background of an image and modifies it according to a given prompt while keeping the subject.

Stability AI's asynchronous edit service that lets users swap backgrounds with AI-generated or uploaded images while adjusting lighting to match the subject. It covers background replacement and generation, relighting under- or over-exposed images, and control of light reference, direction and strength, aimed at e-commerce, real estate and photography.

Meshy's Retexture API applies new textures to an existing 3D model using Meshy's foundation models, driven by a text description of the desired style, a 2D reference image or 1-4 multi-view images. It accepts a previous task ID or a .glb/.gltf/.obj/.fbx/.stl model URL and returns the textured model plus base-colour and optional PBR maps at up to 8K.
Runway's enhancement model that converts SDR video up to 16-bit HDR, outputting HDR10, HLG, ProRes or OpenEXR sequences. It works on uploaded or generated video clips.

A built-in tool of Sakana AI's Namazu model that executes Python code in a sandboxed environment with file access, returning generated files as download URLs valid for one hour. The model calls it autonomously inside its agentic loop, which suits data analysis and visualisation tasks.

A built-in tool of Sakana AI's Namazu model that lets it search the web and retrieve ranked results with snippets, giving the model real-time information for current events and factual queries. The model invokes it autonomously within its agentic loop.

In Braintrust a scorer returns a numeric score between 0 and 1, measuring qualities like factual accuracy, helpfulness or correct formatting. Scorers receive an AI result's input, output, expected value, metadata and trace and can run at span or trace level, so teams can track quality over time, set pass/fail benchmarks and compare outputs.

The Perplexity Search API returns real-time, ranked web results as structured data — title, URL, snippet and dates — without LLM processing, with controls for domains, languages, regions and extracted content. Perplexity recommends it when you need raw results to feed your own models or RAG pipelines, and it runs on the same index that powers Perplexity's answer engine.

Stability AI's Search and Recolor service, a derivative of inpaint that changes the colour of a specific object in an image using a prompt. It automatically segments the object and recolours it using the colours requested in the prompt.

Stability AI's Search and Replace service, similar to inpaint but driven by a prompt instead of a mask: it automatically segments the named object and replaces it with the object requested in the prompt.

Tripo Mesh Segmentation performs semantic segmentation on a 3D model and automatically splits it into parts, taking a task id, file token or URL (GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ, STL up to 150 MB) and returning a segmented GLB plus a rendered preview. Version 2.0 adds labelling, granularity control and optional reference-image guidance.

Stability AI's Sketch control service, which upgrades rough hand-drawn sketches to refined outputs with precise control. For non-sketch images it allows detailed manipulation of the final appearance by leveraging the contour lines and edges within the image.

The lower-cost tier of Patronus's hosted evaluator API, billed per thousand small evaluator API calls. Patronus evaluators are automated functions that score the quality, safety and performance of your LLM outputs.

Tripo Smart Retopology v2.0 is the mesh post-processing task that rebuilds a model's topology into clean, low-polygon geometry suitable for rigging, animation and game engines; Tripo prices the v2.0 Smart tier at 30 credits against 10 for the v1.0 basic tier.

The Brave Spellcheck API provides spell checking for search queries, detecting spelling errors and returning corrected alternatives based on query context and search patterns. It is used for "Did you mean?" features and cleaning user-generated queries, and returns empty results when a query is already correct.

Starlight is Topaz Labs' family of diffusion-based generative video enhancement models, used to restore difficult archival footage and to clean up AI-generated video, recovering detail and refining facial realism while scaling cleanly to 4K.

A cloud browser instance from Steel, a headless browser API for AI engineers, controlled over API or the Python/Node SDKs. A session runs JavaScript, keeps login state through persistent cookies, and returns page data as cleaned HTML, markdown, PDFs or screenshots, with live viewing and session replay for debugging.

Stability AI's Structure control service, which generates images while maintaining the structure of an input image. Stability calls it especially valuable for advanced content creation such as recreating scenes or rendering characters from models.

Stability AI's Style Guide control service, which extracts stylistic elements from an input control image and uses them to guide the creation of an output image based on the prompt, yielding a new image in the same style as the control image.

Stability AI's Style Transfer service, which applies visual characteristics from reference style images to target images. Unlike Style Guide it transforms existing content while preserving the original composition, helping create consistent content across multiple assets.

Tavily Extract is a web-scraping endpoint optimised for LLMs that retrieves and cleans page content from one or more supplied URLs (up to 20 per request), returning raw content as markdown or plain text with optional images and favicons.

Hive's Text Moderation API takes raw text from your content and returns classification scores on a 0-3 severity scale across the sexual, hate, violence, spam and bullying classes, together with profanity and PII pattern matches and language detection. Hive notes the API does not remove content or ban users itself; it returns the data you build your own enforcement logic on.

Meshy's text-to-texture capability, served by the Retexture API, generates textures for an existing 3D model from a text description of the desired style (up to 600 characters). It returns the textured model with base-colour and optional PBR maps (metallic, roughness, normal, emission) at up to 8K, keeping or regenerating the original UV layout.

Tripo Texture regenerates the texture maps of an existing 3D model, guided by a text description, a single reference image, a four-view reference set or a style image plus prompt, with quality levels and optional PBR material generation. It returns a textured GLB and a rendered preview.

Arcade is an enterprise-ready actions runtime for AI agents; a tool call is the mechanism by which an agent invokes one of Arcade's agent-optimized tools across 7,500+ integrated systems such as Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, GitHub and Stripe. Arcade handles the OAuth flows, user tokens and API keys at runtime and provides central governance and audit logging for every call.

Composio's Tool Router replaces per-app MCP server setup with a single pre-signed MCP endpoint scoped to a user and chat session, giving agents dynamic tool discovery and authentication across thousands of tools. Composio calls it a dramatically simpler way to build complex agents and the core way of building on the platform.

The Topaz Labs API's Enhance endpoint upscales, restores and transforms images at scale with the company's proprietary AI models; one credit covers up to 24 megapixels of output, with larger sizes costing more credits.
Vidu Upscale-Pro raises the resolution of a generated video to 1080p, 2K or 4K (and up to 8K on Vidu's price list) as a post-processing step.

Magnific's Upscaler Precision is a faithful, high-fidelity upscaling model that raises resolution while preserving the original content, texture and structure of the image rather than inventing new detail. It minimizes halos, reduces noise, keeps colours accurate and improves the readability of small text and UI, and supports 2x, 4x, 8x and 16x factors — Magnific recommends it for logos, UI, product photos, scans and technical drawings.
Recraft's vectorize endpoint, which converts a raster image into an editable SVG vector image.

HeyGen's Video Translation API translates and dubs an existing video into one or more target languages with voice cloning and lip-sync, covering 175+ languages and dialects. It is exposed at POST /v3/video-translations.

Reka Vision's video Q&A and tagging, which lets you ask questions about video content and get AI-powered answers with streaming support, and generate tags for videos. It works on indexed videos longer than 30 seconds and supports multi-turn questions.

Reka Vision's clip generation, which generates shorter highlight clips from longer videos. Each clip comes back as a rendered video with an AI-generated title, caption, hashtags and an engagement quality score, with control over style, aspect ratio, resolution and subtitles.
Reka Vision's image search, which lets you search through your indexed images using natural language queries and returns matching images ranked by a relevance score.

Reka Vision's image upload operation, which stores images in your account with optional indexing so they can later be retrieved and searched. It returns an id, URL, indexing status and metadata per image.

Reka Vision's video upload and indexing, which ingests a video from a file or URL and pre-processes and stores embeddings for it so search and Q&A can run over its content. It returns a video id, URL, indexing status and technical metadata.

Reka Vision's video search, which finds relevant chunks across your uploaded videos from a natural language query by matching visual content, captions and transcripts. Results carry a confidence score, start and end timestamps and playback URLs.

Hive's Visual Moderation API automatically classifies images and video for sensitive subject matter, returning per-class confidence scores from several model heads (explicit content, weapons, drugs and more) plus timestamps for video. Hive stresses that the API does not remove content or ban users itself, but returns the classification metrics you act on.

Voice is Argil's voice creation and cloning feature for AI avatars: users build a custom voice by uploading 20 seconds to 5 minutes of their own audio, pick one from the public voice library, or generate one from an image. Pro voices add higher-quality cloning through a connected ElevenLabs account, with roughly 30 supported languages and adjustable stability, similarity and style.

Veryfi's W-2 and W-9 OCR API extracts data from US tax forms automatically, reading handwriting and checkboxes and returning structured JSON with employee and employer identity fields, wage and withholding boxes and state and local tax information for tax-preparation, HR and loan workflows.

Resemble AI's watermarking product, which embeds imperceptible signals into audio, image, video and text to prove authenticity and protect IP. The watermarks survive compression and transformation and can be detected later to confirm provenance.

Web Access is the Writer Knowledge Graph capability that fetches web content: adding web connector URLs to a Knowledge Graph automatically extracts and indexes single pages or whole sub-page trees so the content can be queried alongside uploaded files. Writer prices it at $0.12 per page.

Oxylabs Web Scraper API is an all-in-one web data collection platform: you send a target URL or search query and it returns structured, parsed JSON — or raw HTML — without you building scraping infrastructure. It ships pre-configured endpoints for 38+ popular sites and handles proxy rotation, anti-bot protections, JavaScript rendering and location, language and header customization.

A web-grounded answer endpoint: it "performs a search based on the query and generates either a direct answer or a detailed summary with citations", so an application gets a sourced answer rather than a result list.

query — "Natural-language question or instructions for the request"; optional text ("If true, returns full page text with default settings") and stream, where "the response is returned as a server-sent events (SSE) stream".

An answer (direct for specific queries, a detailed summary for open-ended ones) plus citations — "Search results used to generate the answer", with title, URL, publication date, author and source text when requested.
A web search API for AI applications: it executes a search query against the live web and returns ranked, LLM-ready results, optionally with an LLM-generated short answer.
"The search query to execute", plus controls such as search depth (latency vs. relevance tradeoff, from advanced to ultra-fast), max_results (0-20, default 5) and topic (general or news).

An array of results, each with "The title of the search result", "The URL of the search result", "A short description of the search result" and "The relevance score of the search result"; optionally "A short answer to the user's query, generated by an LLM", plus response time and credits used.

fetch_url is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API that retrieves the content of specific web pages — up to 10 URLs per invocation — returning titles, snippets and full page text. It is used when the agent needs the full content of a particular page, article or document rather than search results.

finance_search is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API that plugs an agent into licensed financial datasets, real-time market feeds and cited web sources, returning ticker quotes, market data and financial metrics in a standard schema the model can reason over.

people_search is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API for finding professionals and employees online; the agent generates search queries for the invocation and the tool returns matching results in Perplexity's standard search-result schema.

sandbox is a built-in tool of Perplexity's Agent API that executes code in an isolated container during a request, capturing stdout, stderr, exit code and execution duration so an agent can run scripts and computations securely.

In LangSmith a trace is a collection of runs for a single operation. When one user request makes an agent call a model, run a tool and call the model again, all of those runs belong to the same trace, bound together by a unique trace ID.

The watsonx.ai text extraction service extracts text from PDFs and other highly structured documents and converts it into a format that is easier to work with programmatically, such as Markdown or JSON. It uses OCR for scanned documents and images, preserves tables, section titles, lists and footnotes, strips headers and footers, and can extract key-value pairs from documents such as invoices and utility bills.

docs.text: AlphaEvolve is an evolutionary coding agent powered by large language models for general-purpose algorithm discovery and optimization, pairing Gemini models with automated evaluators that verify answers within an evolutionary framework.

Bland is an enterprise voice AI platform that automates the calls you thought required a human, covering inbound support, scheduling and identity verification as well as outbound lead qualification, confirmations and follow-ups, and replacing IVR phone trees with natural language. It runs on the customer's own infrastructure rather than routing calls through third parties.

Bolt is an AI-powered builder for websites, web apps and mobile apps: you describe an idea in chat and Bolt turns it into a working product, with database, hosting and domains built into the same platform. It runs entirely in the browser, lets you pick your AI agent, and you own the generated code.

Browser Use's Cloud Agent is a hosted service where you give an agent a task and get the result: the agent uses an AI model to understand the objective and drive a browser autonomously, without you controlling it directly.

Compound is Groq's agentic AI system that goes beyond plain LLM text generation by intelligently using built-in tools — Web Search, Visit Website, Code Execution and Wolfram Alpha — to reach real-time information and interact with external environments. It runs on models including GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 4 Scout and Llama 3.3 70B and can make multiple tool calls per request.

Compound Mini is the lighter variant of Groq's Compound system for simpler use cases: it supports a single tool call per request and delivers on average 3x lower latency than Compound, trading multi-step tool capability for speed.

Reducto's agentic extraction mode, which iteratively refines its output to achieve near-perfect accuracy. Instead of a single pass it verifies results against the source document and re-extracts until a quality threshold is met, aimed at complex documents such as invoices, financial statements and long multi-page tables.
Firecrawl's Extract performs LLM-powered structured data extraction from web content in JSON mode, turning unstructured pages into machine-readable records against a custom schema.
A powerful agentic researcher designed for autonomous, multi-step investigations that synthesize complex information into comprehensive, cited reports.

HyperAgent is Hyperbrowser's open-source, Playwright-powered browser automation agent that carries out web tasks described in natural language, clicking, typing and navigating on its own. It runs on Hyperbrowser Cloud either synchronously or as a polled job, and returns the final answer plus step-by-step execution details and a live monitoring URL.

Line is Cartesia's platform for building and deploying intelligent, low-latency voice agents. It combines the Sonic text-to-speech and Ink speech-to-text models while handling audio orchestration and deployment.

LlamaExtract pulls structured data out of documents according to a schema you define (or one it infers), returning the result as JSON. It is one of the six composable products of LlamaIndex's LlamaParse platform and typically runs on the output of Parse.

Lovable is a full-stack AI development platform for building, iterating on and deploying web applications using natural language, with real code, security and enterprise governance. It generates complete applications - frontend, backend, database, authentication and integrations - as editable code you own and can sync to GitHub or GitLab.

Replit Agent is an AI-powered creative partner that turns an idea described in plain language into a working application. Unlike a chatbot that only answers questions, Agent takes action: it sets up your project, creates applications, checks its work and fixes problems along the way, covering web and mobile apps, dashboards, prototypes and documents.

An autonomous web-research agent endpoint: "an async, usage-based endpoint for high-compute tasks like list building, enrichment, and deep research" that "handles complex reasoning and can return many structured output fields".
Asynchronous: use it "when a workflow needs more than a single search or extraction call"; for simpler low-latency needs the docs point to the Search API instead.

Open-ended natural-language instructions for a multi-step research, list-building or enrichment workflow, optionally with a schema for the desired structured output; runs can continue from a previous run.

"Each run can return a natural-language answer, schema-validated JSON, field-level grounding, metadata, and a cost breakdown. You can retrieve completed runs later, list past runs, replay events, or continue from a previous run."

Retell is a platform to build, test, deploy and monitor AI voice and chat agents with telephony, prompts, tools and analytics built in. Agents can be assembled in a no-code node-based dashboard or programmatically via APIs and SDKs, with knowledge bases, CRM connectivity, call-center features and post-call analysis.

A Lingo.dev localization engine is a stateful translation API you build and configure on Lingo.dev, instead of sending content to a generic LLM. It combines five layers - LLM model choice per language pair, brand voice, per-locale rules, a glossary of exact term mappings, and AI reviewers - and accumulates glossary, brand voice and translation memory across requests.

morph-warp-grep-v2 is Morph's dedicated code-search LLM (WarpGrep), running in its own isolated context window and issuing up to 8 parallel tool calls per turn to locate code in about 3.8 steps. It searches local codebases and public GitHub repositories without cloning and returns the relevant context to the calling agent.
